new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R51414
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Location:** Alhambra, CA (Onsite)

 

**Our Team**

SPP is a vertically integrated photonics business focused on the design, fabrication, and delivery of Indium Phosphide (InP) semiconductor laser and gain chips. SPP operates two wafer fabrication facilities in Southern California supporting advanced photonic devices and customer die demand.

 

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering serves as the senior quality leader within SPP Operations and is responsible for building and leading the manufacturing quality organization across both fabrication facilities. The role establishes quality systems, inspection practices, quality metrics, and quality culture while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, and the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering to support business growth and manufacturing excellence.

This position provides leadership for manufacturing quality strategy, execution, and organizational development across both fabrication facilities and is expected to maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor. The role supports Epitaxial Growth, Wafer Fabrication, Bar Processing, Chip Processing, and Test Operations, and works closely with Epitaxy, Process, Product, and Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Test Operations, and Reliability & Failure Analysis.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the SPP Fab Quality organization across both fabrication facilities
* Recruit, develop, and manage quality inspectors while building future technician and quality engineering capabilities
* Establish quality procedures, metrics, escalation processes, reporting systems, and a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement.
* Establish incoming inspection processes, acceptance criteria, and material-control procedures for critical materials including III-V substrates, epitaxial source materials, specialty gases, precious metals, process chemicals, and optical and test consumables
* Verify material certifications; establish supplier qualification, monitoring, corrective-action, and containment processes
* Ensure traceability and disposition tracking.
* Develop and implement in-process quality control systems, containment and escalation processes for quality excursions, and process controls across manufacturing operations
* Monitor process performance and quality trends
* Drive reduction of defects, scrap, rework, and quality escapes; and ensure consistent quality practices across both fabs.
* Implement and maintain manufacturing quality systems, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), CAPA, Non-Conforming Material Report (NCMR) processes, FMEA, and process control plans
* Provide independent quality review and approval of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), process changes, and manufacturing transfers
* Establish and maintain ESD control programs and quality documentation and records.
* Lead investigations of manufacturing quality excursions and process escapes in partnership with Process Engineering and Product Engineering
* Monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk)
* Provide quality leadership for measurement-system capability and MSA activities
* Support tool and process qualification and requalification
* Use quality data to improve process stability, defect reduction, and yield.
* Maintain audit readiness across both fabrication facilities
* Support internal, customer, and ISO audits
* Support contamination-control initiatives and cleanroom environmental monitoring
* Ensure quality documentation meets compliance requirements
* Partner with the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering on corporate quality initiatives and enterprise quality alignment.
Other relevant tasks, as assigned. 

 
 

**Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience: 7+ years of manufacturing quality experience within wafer fabrication, photonics, compound semiconductor, or related advanced manufacturing environments
* Leadership: 3+ years of people leadership experience
* Strong knowledge of SPC, CAPA, NCMR, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and manufacturing quality systems
* Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective-action programs
* Experience supporting semiconductor wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Experience working effectively across Operations and Engineering functions 

 

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in wafer-fab quality within silicon semiconductor, compound semiconductor, photonics, III-V semiconductor, optoelectronics, or optical communications manufacturing environments
* Experience supporting epitaxial growth operations
* Experience building or scaling manufacturing quality organizations within multi-site manufacturing environments
* Experience with supplier-quality programs and semiconductor MES systems
* Comfortable operating in evolving, high-mix manufacturing environments with limited historical data
Desire to learn InP epitaxial growth, wafer fabrication, and photonics manufacturing technologies

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.

new_roles.description:
**Join Our Team!**

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

**Job Description Summary**

Position Objective: 
The General Manager, Manufacturing oversees all aspects of manufacturing processes to ensure proven product functionality with a sustainable return on investment (ROI). The General Manager Manufacturing manages subordinate staff and coordinates with remote departments that are responsible for engineering development and manufacturing engineering. This candidate must have proven supervisory and technical skills, and an appreciation for the complex nature of the rental HVAC industry. Personal skills that will be required include exceptional business foresight, superlative communication skills, working knowledge of several engineering disciplines and how they relate to one another, and an aptitude for managing risk.

Position Responsibilities: 

* Develops and promotes a “Zero Harm Safety Culture” leveraging Sunbelt’s Engage for Life Safety programs, fine tuning safety policy as it relates to manufacturing operations
* Has overall financial responsibility of local manufacturing operation, inventory, budgeting, cost controls, capital equipment acquisition and manufacturing facilities
* In partnership with senior management, develops and implements manufacturing plans support growth, safety and manufacturing efficiencies
* Develops the manufacturing management team, inspiring leadership through empowerment, coaching and accountability
* Develops manufacturing forecast and roughcut capacity plans
* Communicates with fleet planning, coordinating changing priorities and product deliveries
* Utilizes proven continuous improvement strategies to refine manufacturing processes and products, that minimize scrap, reduce rework & line failures and has emphasis on building the highest quality equipment at the lowest costs
* Establishes, implements, and maintains administrative policies, procedures, and standards
* Ensures production facility adheres to all local, national laws, including labor and environmental
* Develops long-term strategic initiatives for manufacturing operations
* Maintains knowledge of new trends, developments, technologies, materials, and best practices; applies this knowledge to continually improve product lines and production efficiency

Requirements: 
Education & Experience: 

* Degree in Business Administration or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operation (metal fabrication & production assembly environments experience preferred)
* Possesses knowledge and understanding of manufacturing processes and systems, engineering systems, and product inventory management, manufacturing accounting and ERP systems
* Analytical and mathematical mind, capable of evaluating and solving various complex problems
* Leadership skills necessary to manage several experienced and driven teams, including proven supervisory and technical skills
* Self-motivated attitude with the ability to multitask and thrive in a timeline-driven environment
* Interpersonal communication skills with expertise in distilling complicated topics to a broader

Base Pay Range: $108,430.00 - 149,091.80

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Please visit https://www.sunbeltrentals.com/careers/ for more information on our benefits and to join our Talent Network. 
 
Sunbelt also provides a comprehensive benefits package to its full-time employees. This package includes:

* Health, Dental and Vision plans
* 401(k) Match
* Volunteer time off
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Accident, Life and Travel insurance, as well as flexible spending
* Tuition Reimbursement Options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Length of Service Awards

You will become eligible for benefits on the first of the month following 30 days from your start date. Sunbelt offers team members the following paid time off from work, subject to Sunbelt’s policies (unless specified in a collective bargaining agreement):

* 5 sick days

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations
new_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Manager Operations to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. This is an on-site position based in Santa Maria, CA. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to ensure the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This role drives operational performance through effective resource planning, workforce development, and process optimization while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partnering cross-functionally, the Senior Manager implements operational strategies, promotes accountability, and ensures efficient manufacturing execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

**Operational Leadership & Performance**

* Lead and oversee daily manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to achieve safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap reduction, and work-in-process (WIP) inventory objectives.
* Establish, monitor, and drive accountability for key operational performance indicators (KPIs), implementing corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, collaborating with relevant stakeholders, and implementing improvements within manufacturing operations.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Oversee all phases of manufacturing operations to ensure production activities comply with established procedures, quality standards, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Plan, coordinate, and optimize departmental activities, production schedules, and resource allocation to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Evaluate production capacity, workforce requirements, and operational constraints to ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, and manufacturing resources.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Lead, develop, and manage production and associated functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, and employee development to maintain operational readiness.
* Establish performance expectations, evaluate employee performance, and partner with Human Resources on coaching, employee relations, corrective actions, and performance management.

**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, AS9100 standards, applicable aerospace regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
* Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance by ensuring employees are appropriately trained and consistently follow established manufacturing procedures.

**Financial Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Manage departmental budgets, monitor operational expenditures, and implement cost-control measures to support financial objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, align production priorities, and meet customer delivery commitments.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education**:

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Associate degree, technical/trade certification, or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing production teams, operational performance, and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated success managing manufacturing operations in a complex, quality-driven production environment, with a focus on improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Proven ability to lead supervisors or managers, develop high-performing teams, and drive operational improvements across multiple manufacturing functions.

**Skills**:

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop teams, establish accountability, and manage employee performance.
* Proficiency in manufacturing operations, production planning, workforce allocation, and capacity management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational KPIs and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of budget management, cost control, and resource optimization within a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support business objectives.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft interiors, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, with knowledge of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and manufacturing performance reporting tools.

**Other**:

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.? Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to operational personnel to achieve organizational goals, operational performance objectives, and budgetary targets. Responsible for employee development, performance management, and building organizational capability.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and implement solutions to complex operational challenges that are consistent with organizational objectives and established business practices.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Salary Range Transparency:** $125,500 - $185,000

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture
* Potential for growth within organization

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

The Senior Director, Operations is a strategic operations leadership role responsible for scaling a $1.5B+ manufacturing campus and multi-site footprint through digital transformation, operational excellence, and high-impact leadership to enable accelerated growth and customer value. While this role carries responsibility for long-term operational strategy, digital transformation, capacity planning, and Smart Factory initiatives, the immediate mandate is centered on stabilizing and transforming one of nVent's most important manufacturing operations globally. The Anoka campus represents approximately $1.5 billion in annual revenue and employs roughly 1,700 people today, with expected growth toward 2,000 employees in the coming years. It is the largest manufacturing operation in the United States and the second-largest globally within nVent's manufacturing network.

 

Reporting directly to the Vice President, Integrated Supply Chain of the Systems Protection Segment, this role will have significant visibility across the organization and will play a critical role in shaping the future operating model of one of nVent's most strategically important manufacturing assets. Success in this role will create meaningful opportunities for broader enterprise leadership responsibility within nVent's global Integrated Supply Chain organization.

 

Key Responsibilities:

* Champion a high-performance continuous improvement culture by embedding Lean and problem-solving disciplines across all levels of the organization; empower employees to identify waste, implement solutions, and deliver sustainable gains while formally recognizing exceptional performance and contributions.
* Lead large-scale, multi-site operational transformation across a large scaled flagship campus and additional high-growth plants, ensuring alignment of capacity, capability, and talent strategies to support accelerated business growth and evolving customer demand.
* Drive Smart Factory / Digital Manufacturing advancement by scaling production capability through strategic investments in automation, advanced tooling, equipment, and data-driven systems (Industry 4.0), while balancing legacy operations with next-generation technologies to optimize throughput, quality, and cost.
* Own end-to-end operational performance across Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Facilities, Material Handling, and Business Support functions, ensuring disciplined execution against safety, quality, delivery, cost, and cash flow objectives
* Develop and execute integrated strategic business plans that translate enterprise objectives into site-level actions, including long-range capacity planning, capital deployment (CapEx), workforce strategy, and footprint optimization across multiple locations.
* Serve as a key leader and cross-functional partner, collaborating with senior leadership, supply chain, engineering, and commercial teams to align short- and long-term operational strategies, remove constraints, and ensure successful new product introductions and business expansion.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a large, diverse organization by building strong leadership benches, strengthening succession pipelines, and fostering accountability, engagement, and inclusion across all functions and sites.
* Leverage data and operational analytics to drive decision-making, identifying bottlenecks, improving asset utilization (OEE), optimizing material flow, and prioritizing high-impact investments that enable scalability and profitability.
* Establish robust communication channels and employee engagement mechanisms to proactively monitor organizational health, gather feedback, and address concerns in partnership with Human Resources—ensuring a strong, transparent, and trust-based culture across all locations.
* Ensure world-class safety, compliance, and sustainability performance, reinforcing a zero-harm culture while maintaining adherence to environmental regulations, responsible sourcing practices, and corporate governance standards.
* Establish and sustain a rigorous management operating system across the campus, including daily management, tiered accountability processes, visual management, structured problem solving, and disciplined escalation practices that enable rapid identification and resolution of operational issues.
* Drive stabilization and performance improvement initiatives across critical manufacturing lines, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, and productivity commitments while restoring operational predictability and customer confidence.
* Lead the continued development of a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, transparency, problem solving, and employee engagement, creating an environment where issues are surfaced early, addressed rapidly, and solved at their root cause.
* Evaluate and optimize material flow, production layout, workforce deployment, and capacity utilization across the campus, balancing immediate operational needs with long-term scalability requirements.
Partner closely with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Lean, Human Resources, and Finance leaders to strengthen organizational capability, improve execution, and ensure alignment around operational priorities and business objectives. 

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

* The ideal candidate will bring a BA or BS degree in Business, Engineering or similar field; MBA or other graduate degree is preferred.
* Deep understanding of lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies (TPM, Kaizen) within high-volume environments.
* Strong command of Smart Factory technologies, including IoT integration, predictive maintenance, automated material handling, and data-driven shop floor management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of EHS (Environmental, Health, and Safety) compliance, supply chain logistics, strategic procurement, and capital expenditure (CapEx) management.
* Expertise in long-range capacity planning, workforce strategy, and balancing the operational requirements of legacy product lines with the agility needed for new product introductions (NPI).
* Proficiency in P&L management, budget forecasting, and aligning plant-level performance metrics with enterprise-wide financial objectives.
* Ability to translate corporate strategy into actionable site-level plans and orchestrate cross-functional teams toward common goals.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale cultural and technical shifts, including the transition to digital manufacturing environments while maintaining stable output.
* Skill in leveraging operational analytics to identify bottlenecks, optimize production capability, and justify capital investments.
* Exceptional ability to foster open, transparent communication across all levels—from the shop floor to the executive boardroom—and effectively partner with Human Resources on organizational health.
* Proven ability to build, mentor, and inspire high-performing teams, fostering an environment of psychological safety and professional growth.
* Ability to navigate complex matrix organizations and collaborate effectively with stakeholders in Sales, Engineering, Finance, and HR to execute short- and long-term plans.
* Capacity to remain decisive and calm under pressure, managing the competing demands of high-growth production spikes, technical troubleshooting, and daily operational hurdles.•Ability to balance immediate, reactive operational needs with long-term, proactive improvements in infrastructure, tooling, and site facilities.
* Aptitude for cultivating a high-engagement, inclusive workplace that promotes active employee participation in problem-solving and recognizes performance excellence.

**WE HAVE:**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

 + nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
 + Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com .

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

 + We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
 + Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

* Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

 + Innovative & adaptable
 + Dedicated to absolute integrity
 + Focused on the customer first
 + Respectful and team oriented
 + Optimistic and energizing
 + Accountable for performance

* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Pay Transparency** 
 
nVent’s pay scale is based on the expected range of base pay for this job and the employee’s work location. Employee pay within this range will be based on a combination of factors including knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, education, and performance. Where federal, state, or local minimum wage requirements exist, employee pay will comply.
 
 
**Compensation Range:**

$204,400.00 - $304,000.00

Depending on the position offered, employee may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as annual incentives.

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operations Engineering - C&I
new_roles.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

**Sr Director, Operations Engineering**
=======================================

The Sr Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for leading the enterprise Operations Engineering function with a focus on New Product Launches, Operations Integrations, Product Moves, and Operations Standards. This role ensures that new products, newly integrated operations, and transferred products are launched and sustained in manufacturing safely, on time, at quality, and at target cost. Through the development and deployment of enterprise standards, best practices, and the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS), the Director drives consistent, world-class execution across the Order-to-Cash process (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver & Service). The role partners closely with Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Business Unit leadership, and supports Generac's global manufacturing portfolio.

**Major Responsibilities**
--------------------------

### **New Product Launches (NPI)**

* Lead and coordinate the successful launch of New Product Introductions (NPI) within operations, from early design involvement through production ramp and sustained performance.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, including process design, PFMEA, line layout, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and capacity planning.
* Partner with Product Engineering to drive design for manufacturability and assembly so new products launch with optimal cost, quality, and delivery.
* Establish launch gates, readiness criteria, and success metrics, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to them.
* Lead and support the introduction of new and revised processes and technologies that support cost reduction and competitive advantage.

### **Operations Integrations**

* Lead the operational integration of new sites, acquisitions, and expanded capacity into the Generac manufacturing network, aligning processes, systems, and performance expectations.
* Lead and contribute to facility transformation, including layout, mixed-model lines, value stream design, and deployment of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS).
* Assess integrated facilities, infrastructure systems, and technology against best-in-class capability and develop roadmaps to close gaps.
* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with HR, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and senior leadership to ensure integrations meet business objectives.
* Incorporate workplace optimization, space planning, and long-term facility planning into integration plans.

### **Product Moves & Transfers**

* Lead the planning and execution of product moves and technology transfers between facilities and with external supply chain partners, ensuring continuity of supply, quality, and cost.
* Own and continuously improve the product transfer procedure, and support the Operations Product Transfer Steering Committee to ensure alignment and adherence to the procedure.
* Develop transfer plans that include capacity validation, equipment and tooling relocation, process validation, training, and inventory bridge strategies.
* Partner with Business Unit and Manufacturing Strategy leaders to support footprint, rebalancing, and new capacity decisions with sound operations engineering analysis.

### **Operations Standards**

* Develop with corporate Advanced Manufacturing, deploy, and sustain enterprise operations engineering standards, policies, procedures, and process documentation that drive consistent execution across all facilities.
* Drive significant contributions to the implementation of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS) across the Order-to-Cash process.
* Develop and implement operating methodologies designed to maximize floor space utilization, asset uptime and utilization, eliminate waste, and reduce operating cost.
* Champion lean principles and continuous improvement, and ensure the ongoing success of process improvement initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate productivity, engineering output, launch performance, and facility efficiency, using data to drive improvement.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, and incorporate sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

### **Project Management & Financial Stewardship**

* Drive and project manage major cost, quality, and delivery initiatives, with a strong focus on breakthrough process and technology improvements.
* Facilitate project flow through regular engagement with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, managing shifting priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Oversee capital projects related to launches, integrations, and product moves, and provide budgetary figures for future fiscal year planning.
* Manage the operations engineering budget and support reduction of the operating cost of each facility consistent with company objectives.

### **Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead the Operations Engineering team, including project planning, technical guidance, and resource allocation across sites and initiatives.
* Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and project managers, setting objectives that align with company strategy.
* Manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning, and development, ensuring feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
* Provide guidance to cross-functional teams and leadership on key decisions related to investment in core manufacturing technologies, processes, and systems.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or Industrial Technology.
* **Work Experience:** 10+ years of related experience in Operations Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, including leading new product launches and product transfers.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of increasing responsibility for project and/or people management involving a broad range of operational technologies and processes.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of New Product Development, PFMEA, and operations engineering principles.
* Knowledge of lean principles, continuous improvement, and end-to-end supply chain principles.
* Experience operating in both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume, low-mix production environments.
* Ability to assess and manage end-to-end processes and to manage strategic and tactical issues by being hands-on.
* Ability to develop and deploy standards and best practices across multiple sites.
* Ability to attract, develop, and manage an impactful team.
* Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with shifting priorities and moving deadlines.
* Proficiency in a CAD platform (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and/or ProE), MS Office, and ERP platforms.

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

* Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.
* Project Management certification (e.g., PMP).
* Experience deploying processes and standards at an enterprise level, both internally and with external supply chain partners.
* Experience leading operations integrations, facility transformations, and multi-site product transfers.
* Experience working in an international company and in matrix organizations, with multi-site support experience.
* Previous experience using SAP or an equivalent ERP.
* Experience with facilities engineering and with using and/or implementing CMMS systems.
* Large-scale project management experience.

*“We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”*

new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

Role summary: The (USA) Director, Operations leads the execution of complex projects and programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives through strategic planning, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. This role directs operational initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and drive business growth while managing budgets and performance standards. The Director fosters strong partnerships across teams to implement innovative solutions and continuous improvements. By leveraging analytical insights and operational expertise, this position supports decision-making processes and promotes a culture of accountability, integrity, and excellence to achieve sustainable organizational success. About the team: The team drives the transformation of Walmart’s fulfillment capabilities to enhance the customer experience through strategic program management and data-driven decision-making. It leads initiatives across speed, assortment, pricing, and recovery by collaborating with Product, Pricing, Walmart+, Merchandising, Network, Operations, Analytics, and Finance teams. Focused on identifying challenges, designing tests, and scaling solutions, the team ensures alignment with Walmart’s goals through effective stakeholder engagement, financial oversight, and business operations. This collaborative environment emphasizes innovation and operational excellence to deliver impactful, scalable results.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**What you'll do:**
 

* Oversee execution of complex projects and programs, managing timelines, budgets, and performance standards to ensure successful implementation.
* Analyze data and business trends to develop actionable recommendations aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead cross-functional teams to design and implement process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders to support business initiatives and drive execution.
* Develop and monitor scorecards and tracking mechanisms to measure outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Foster talent development through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning to maintain a skilled workforce.
* Promote adherence to company standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance across teams.

 
**What you'll bring:**
 

* Extensive experience in operations management and leading large-scale complex projects with proven ability to manage timelines, budgets, and performance metrics.
* Strong proficiency in business strategy development, data analysis, and translating insights into actionable recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
* Demonstrated success in cross-functional team leadership, fostering collaboration to drive process improvements and operational efficiency.
* Expertise in developing and implementing innovative solutions to reduce costs and enhance business outcomes.
* Proven capability in talent development, mentoring, and succession planning to build and sustain high-performing teams.
* Commitment to integrity, ethical leadership, and promoting a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
 
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
 
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.

***Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team driving a safer transportation system for Arizona.***
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **MVD Deputy Division Director of Operations**

Job Location:

#### **Address: Motor Vehicle Division** **1801 W. Jefferson St.** **Phoenix, AZ 85007**

Posting Details:

#### **Salary Range: $155,000 - $165,000**

#### **Anticipated Salary: $160,000**

#### **Grade: 32**

#### **Closing Date: 11/12/2026**

Job Summary:

Works closely with the Division Director as a senior member of Division leadership, overseeing operations and developing, sponsoring and overseeing operational improvements. Directs implementation of effective controls to ensure integrity of Division work flow, processes, and products. Reviews operational progress toward completion of initiatives to meet strategic targets and redirects efforts and resources as needed. Collaborates with the rest of MVD leadership to refine and implement MVD’s strategic plan. Collaborates with internal and external partners, stakeholders and customers to direct the design and implementation of improvements and solutions to various issues. Supports process improvement initiatives and serves as an executive sponsor of process improvement projects. Travel may be required, including overnight stays.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

Operational oversight: Oversees daily administrative operations, including managing risk, budget, delivery of results and overall agency operational performance.
 
 
Process optimization: Streamline internal systems, eliminate waste, introduce performance metrics (KPIs), and continuously improve operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness
 
 
Strategy and Vision: Works closely with the Division Director to develop and translate vision and strategies into division operations. Travel may be required, including overnight stays.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:
 

* Training and employee development best practices
* Federal and state legislative process
* Audit and program compliance
* Personnel management
* Lean or other recognized process improvement
* AI concepts, tools and methodologies
* Political processes

 
Skill in:
 

* Operational management and political acumen
* Communicating effectively and concisely, both orally and in writing
* Presenting clearly articulated data, anticipating leadership questions
* Leadership and communication, including influencing and negotiating
* Building consensus among internal and external stakeholders
* Developing and implementing metrics and measurement systems
* Statistical analysis

 
Ability to:
 

* Lead, manage, and monitor programs
* Implement and lead change initiatives
* Work in highly variable assignments
* Analyze information and data, and prepare reports
* Identify and draw on analytical tools and techniques to develop creative approaches and new insights to business issues
* Conduct research; using gathered data, develop recommendations for improvement
* Assess current and future staffing needs based on organizational goals and budget constraints
* Recommend and implement effective business and process controls
* Collaborate and build business relationships

Selective Preference(s):

Extensive experience in change management, planning, management of large scale organization operations.

Pre-Employment Requirements:

This position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job, and the following requirements apply. Any employee operating a motor vehicle on State business must possess and retain a current, valid class-appropriate driver’s license, complete all required training, and successfully pass all necessary driver’s license record checks. The license must be current, unexpired, and neither revoked nor suspended. Employees who drive on state business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records, and must complete all required driver training. An employee who operates a personally owned vehicle on state business shall maintain the statutorily required liability insurance (see Arizona Administrative Code (A.A.C.) R2-10-207.11).

All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).

* Sick leave

* Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program).
* Health and dental insurance
* Retirement plan
* Life insurance and long-term disability insurance
* Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance

By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.

Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page

Retirement:

Mandatory participation in the Arizona Retirement System (ASRS) is required.

For questions about this career opportunity, please contact ADOT Human Resources Recruitment via email at srecruitment@azdot.gov or phone call at (602) 712-8186 option 2.

The State of Arizona is an Equal Opportunity/Reasonable Accommodation Employer. Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

### **About the Role**

Parachute Health is building the definitive platform for ordering home medical equipment and supplies, helping clinicians and suppliers ensure that millions of patients each year receive the critical equipment and supplies they need. Our Merchandising Operations team (AKA "Merch") comprises Category Managers and Category Analysts who have three primary jobs: 1) build and maintain our catalog, 2) build and maintain our coverage criteria rules engine, and 3) partner with R&D to improve the tools and workflows behind both. Merch sits at the intersection of e-commerce, compliance, operations, and R&D, and its work is central to Parachute's core functionality. Clinicians use our catalog to find and order the right equipment for their patients, and suppliers rely on it to fulfill those orders. Our coverage criteria help users determine whether an item should be covered by the patient's insurance.

The Merch team's work is nuanced and detail-dense: we maintain information on tens of thousands of products so our software, and the people who use it, can rely on it. The 18-person team splits its time between project work, like building and redesigning product categories and turning payer rules into qualification questions, and ticket-based work, resolving complex requests escalated by our support and partner teams. Our work requires efficient operational processes and excellent documentation.

As Director of Merchandising Operations, you will own the team's operating framework: how work is planned, prioritized, and delivered, and how the team partners with other teams across Parachute. You'll coach and develop a mix of managers and individual contributors, lead the team's largest cross-functional projects, and serve as a close thought partner to the SVP of Merchandising.

The role is primarily internal (roughly 90%), with occasional customer communication, especially on escalations, that calls for a steady, polished hand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the operational leader for a highly motivated, highly capable team of managers and individual contributors: keep work running smoothly, protect morale, and learn and add to a team culture that is already strong.
* Drive key projects: stay close to the work and personally drive the team's largest, most complex projects, including timelines, dependencies, and cross-team communication.
* Know every team process end to end. Lead the creation, maintenance, and centralization of SOPs and shared resources; drive consistent practices, training, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across category teams.
* Collaborate with partner teams (e.g., Supplier Implementation, Product, Customer Success) so handoffs and shared processes run smoothly.
* Be a Merch advocate: make the team's work understandable and visible across the company.
* Run bandwidth and capacity planning; flag risks early and rebalance coverage.
* Define and report on team metrics (ticket throughput, SLAs, SKU work, rollout milestones).
* Own escalations as needed, partnering effectively with people at all levels across the organization.
* Support recruiting as needed, own onboarding for new merchants, and maintain continuity coverage for every category.

### **Requirements**

* 7+ years in operations, program delivery, or management or technology consulting (e.g., a Big Four or top-tier firm), with 3+ years managing and growing managers.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects using a clear, repeatable methodology.
* Data-driven: comfortable with capacity models, dashboards and prioritization trade-offs.
* Willingness to travel roughly once a quarter.

### **More About You**

* Passionate about improving patient outcomes in the healthcare space.
* Gets things done: drives work to completion and builds processes that stick.
* Thrives in complex, nuanced domains; quickly learns intricate systems (e.g., insurance coverage rules, product data) well enough to make sound calls.
* Clear, concise communicator who pushes back constructively and drives decisions.
* Sound compliance judgment: in a highly regulated industry, you know which issues to resolve and which to escalate.
* Track record of growing into increasing scope and responsibility.
* Nice to have: catalog, product data or e-commerce experience; healthcare, DME/HME or payer experience.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
* Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Equity Incentive Plan
* Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
* Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
* Flexible Vacation Policy
* Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
* Home Office and Wellness Stipend
* Monthly Internet Stipend
* Annual Learning and Development Stipend

### **Base Salary Range (based on level and experience)**

$145,000-$180,000

JOB ID: R-259392 LOCATION: United States - Remote WORK LOCATION TYPE: Remote DATE POSTED: Nov. 02, 2026 CATEGORY: Clinical SALARY RANGE: -

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
--------------------------------------------

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 
 
 

**Local Study Operations Manager (LSOM), Director**
---------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the country LSOM organization and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, cost, and compliant execution of the country clinical study portfolio. The role achieves results through LSOM Senior Managers and their FTE and FSP teams, translating global clinical development strategy into country operating priorities. The role directs portfolio delivery, resource and capacity strategy, financial planning, quality and risk management, vendor performance, and inspection readiness from feasibility through study close-out. As a member of the country leadership team, this role influences study placement and portfolio decisions, leads the resolution of significant operational issues, develops organizational capability and succession plans, and represents LSOM operations in country, regional, and global governance forums.

 
 

**Accountabilities**

* Lead the successful delivery of the country study portfolio through the LSOM management organization, ensuring alignment with global clinical development priorities.

* Provides strategic direction and leadership to LSOM country organization across the full study lifecycle, including feasibility, study execution, and study close-out.

* Establishes portfolio-level oversight of delivery, quality, risk, timelines, and performance, directing timely escalation and resolution of critical issues for LSOM management organization.

* Manage LSOM and LSOM vendor performance to guarantee high-quality study execution, serving as the primary escalation point for local study challenges, driving solutions, and ensuring portfolio targets are met within the country.

* Build leadership capability within the LSOM organization through targeted coaching, development, and succession planning, preparing LSOMs to lead increasingly complex trials and programs.

* Establishes strong operating partnerships with Clinical Research Associate (CRA) organization to support study start-up, monitoring, issue resolution, and compliant trial execution across the country portfolio.

* Cultivate a high-performing, accountable, and inclusive organization focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Champion strong integration between study strategy and local execution teams to translate portfolio priorities into effective country-level delivery.

* Strengthen cross-functional alignment and accountability across country teams to accelerate execution and deliver portfolio commitments.

* Influences study-placement and portfolio investment decisions by providing strategic insight into country's capabilities, operational readiness, performance, and growth potential.

* Anticipates portfolio-level delivery risks, quality trends, and evolving resource requirements, directing mitigation strategies and systemic improvements across country operations.

* Sponsor initiatives that advance operational efficiency, digital innovation, organizational capability, and the adoption of leading practices.

* Direct resource strategy, capacity planning, and workload allocation across FSP and FTE LSOM teams to optimize execution and align resources with global priorities.

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, GCP, ICH, and organizational standards across the country's study portfolio.

Partner with the Regional Head/Country Head and senior cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, establish accountability for trial deliverables, and resolve significant escalations. 



**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional leader for LSOM Senior Managers and the broader LSOM team, including both FSP and FTE, to optimize trial execution and align with global priorities. including strategy and execution, managing risks and escalations

* Partners closely with CRAs, CSPO, Quality, and FSP partners.

* Leads the coordination among country functional teams to ensure successful delivery of the country portfolio.

* Ensure inspection readiness and provide hands-on support during inspections, including responsibility for storyboards.

* Sponsors continuous operational improvement initiatives and encourage sharing of best practices.

* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory and quality standards.

* Collaborate with the Regional Head/Country Head to engage cross-functional stakeholders, align on trial deliverables, and manage escalations as needed.

**Capability Building and People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop LSOM Sr Managers, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership bench development.

* Build the organizational capabilities, resourcing needed to meet the current and future regional portfolio requirements.

* Foster a high-performing, inclusive, accountable, and patient-focused culture across geographically distributed teams.

* Lead organizational changes and enable adoption of new operating models, technologies

**Authority**

* Accountable for country level oversight and delivery of clinical trials.

* Manage the performance of LSOM Senior Managers and their teams

* Holds line management authority for regional and country operations leaders, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and capability building.

* Sets regional delivery goals, operating expectations, and performance standards across study start-up, site engagement, monitoring, execution, and closeout.

* Capability build, talent and performance management, and acting as a liaison for cultural differences within region.

**Outputs**

* Manage LSOM resources in accordance with the global study strategy.

* Oversee resource allocation and workload balance across LSOMs.

* Handle FSP supplier resource coordination and monitor performance through quality oversight metrics.

* Identify and report any risks or compliance concerns related to FSP activities.

* Escalate issues to the Regional/Country Head as necessary.

**What we expect of you**

 
 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Doctorate degree and 4 years of clinical research experience OR
* Master’s degree and 7 years of clinical research experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of clinical research experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4 years of direct managerial and/or leadership experience or equivalent

* Deep knowledge of ICH GCP, ICH E6(R3), ICH E8(R1), and global regulatory expectations for risk-based monitoring and clinical trial oversight.

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional initiatives within a global matrix organization

* Strong Project Management experience

* Experience managing multiple teams / direct reports across multiple clinical functions / trials

* Experience at, or oversight of, clinical research vendors (CROs, central labs, imaging vendors, etc.)

* Experience managing clinical operations across relevant geography / region, including strong understanding of local regulatory requirements around global clinical trials

**What you can expect of us**
-----------------------------

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

Base Salary Range: $195,876-265,008

 
 

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

* A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
* A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
* Stock-based long-term incentives
* Award-winning time-off plans

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Description Director of Operations - Hybrid

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a high-caliber, transformative **Director of Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize our operations. In this role, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for driving operational excellence, customer advocacy, and regulatory integrity across a multi-faceted organization.

 
 

You will move beyond routine contact center management to steer a dynamic organization comprised of specialized internal operational teams—covering strategic readiness, advanced customer advocacy, and complex fraud/escalation management—alongside large-scale BPO vendor partners managing ~200+ frontline agents.

 
 

You bring a blend of strategic vision, process optimization discipline, vendor governance, and high-impact people leadership required to elevate operational standards and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.

 
 

**You have a proven track record of:**

* **Large-Scale Operations Leadership**: Successfully leading multi-site contact center operations combining internal teams and offshore/nearshore vendor partners of 200+ headcount.
* **Operational Transformation**: Transforming reactive service centers into proactive, quality-focused customer advocacy hubs through structured process engineering.
* **Escalation & Fraud Management**: Effectively mitigating enterprise risk through robust Tier 2 & 3 complaint handling, fraud prevention protocols, and regulatory adherence.
* **Vendor Operations Governance**: Driving rigorous SLA performance, cost efficiency, and quality alignment across third-party BPO vendor organizations.
 

 

**What you’ll do:**

The Director of Operations maintains end-to-end accountability for operational strategy, performance delivery, vendor oversight, and organizational readiness.

* **Leadership Reach**: Direct oversight of Department Managers, Unit Managers (UMs), and Vendor Managers (VMs) across internal and external business units.
* **Core Internal Operations**:
 + **Strategic Operations:** Driving CX quality call listening, 1:1 and group coaching/training, operations readiness, and training materials maintenance.
 + **Customer Advocacy:** Overseeing high-touch inbound customer service, task execution, complex account resolution, and U.S. transfer handling.
 + **Escalations and Fraud**: Leading high-severity escalated problem solving, fraud operations, customer complaint research and resolution, and escalation follow-ups.
* **Core External Operations:**
 + Governance and SLA performance tracking for primary vendor partners overseeing a network of ~200+ non-associate vendor agents performing inbound calls and funding workflows.

 

**Key Focus Areas:**

* Reimagine end to end Operations in this era of AI
* Strategic Leadership & Governance to formulate and execute long-term operational strategies and partner cross functionally
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Business Analysis, and Process teams to establish and update processes, policies, procedures, and standards
* Define operational KPIs, quality targets, and SLA metrics to ensure consistent service delivery, funding accuracy, and customer satisfaction
* Direct vendor management leads to oversee third-party partners, ensuring ~200+ vendor agents adhere to operational guidelines and productivity benchmarks
* Risk, Fraud, & Complaint Resolution spanning complex problem solving and root-cause analysis
* Ensure business readiness for product launches, process updates, and technology enhancements across all operational sub-functions
* Mentor, develop, and inspire a multi-layered leadership team, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
* Optimize talent allocation and capacity planning across teams to handle volume fluctuations dynamically.
 

 

**Location:** Plano, TX - This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

* Bachelor’s degree or military experience
* At least 5 years of people leadership experience
* At least 5 years of process or project management experience
* At least 5 years of relationship management experience
* At least 5 years of experience delivering transformational initiatives

* PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
* At least 3 years of operations people leadership experience
* At least 7 years of people leadership experience
