Overview

:

**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Regional Director – Quality provides leadership for the assigned platforms’ clinical quality program. In partnership with physician leadership, the Regional Director – Quality supports clinical quality improvement, patient safety, clinician education, and quality governance. The Regional Director – Quality collaborates with facility partners, USAP’s data analytics team, and corporate leadership to advance quality initiatives and support physician-led clinical excellence.

Job Highlights

:

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: (*The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)*

 

* Leads the platform's clinical quality program in collaboration with physician leadership.
* Supports implementation of local and enterprise quality initiatives.
* Identifies opportunities to improve clinical quality and patient safety.
* Coordinates platform participation in enterprise quality initiatives, as applicable.
* Manages the case review process in collaboration with the local Clinical Quality Committee (CQC).
* Reviews unexpected clinical outcomes, referrals, trends, and other quality concerns.
* Conducts review of clinical events and recommends opportunities for system or practice improvement.
* Escalates issues through established governance pathways, as appropriate.
* Facilitates the development and implementation of quality improvement initiatives.
* Evaluates the effectiveness of quality improvement initiatives.
* Shares best practices across platforms.
* Develops and coordinates clinician education arising from quality initiatives, patient safety activities, case reviews, and other clinically relevant topics identified by the platform CQC.
* Orients new clinicians to the platform’s quality program.
* Supports the development, implementation, and ongoing review of clinical protocols and practice guidelines in collaboration with physician leadership.
* Reviews patient satisfaction feedback and trends to identify opportunities to improve clinical quality and patient safety.
* Partners with the data analytics team to define quality reporting needs, including relevant dashboards.
* Identifies data-informed opportunities for improvement in collaboration with the platform CQC.
* Supports the platform CQC.
* Partners with facility quality and physician leaders to advance quality initiatives, including representing the platform on facility quality committees, as appropriate.
* Coordinates quality reporting required by facility and payor contracts and applicable regulatory agencies.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

:

**K****NOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES** **(KSAs):**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare or related field required, master’s degree preferred.
* 5+ years’ progressively responsible healthcare quality experience, preferably in a physician practice, ambulatory, or perioperative setting.
* Knowledge of quality improvement principles and patient safety.
* Knowledge of Power BI preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements relevant to physician practice.
* Knowledge of clinical quality review methodologies and quality governance processes.
* Ability to interpret quality data and trends.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead and facilitate committee discussions and communicate complex information to diverse audiences.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with clinicians, facility leaders, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience leading quality improvement initiatives across multiple sites.
* Demonstrated ability to influence through collaboration and trust building.
* Demonstrated commitment to professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team.

* *The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully p**er**form the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* *Occasional Standing*
* *Occasional Walking*
* *Frequent Sitting*
* *Frequent hand, finger movement*
* *Use office equipment (in office or remote)*
* *Communicate verbally and in writing*

Help shape the backbone of AI by delivering reliable, efficient power for hyperscale data centers—driving innovation in one of the most dynamic markets of our time.

Your role 
Key responsibilities in your new role

* + **Shape, manage and develop a global quality team for power modules that is equipped to define quality and reliability plans, technical problem solving and cross functional collaboration.**
 + Be responsible for Quality **Management of the power module lifecycle for products and technologies within a very dynamic product line.**
 + Define and maintain **quality targets (corporate and department targets) out of requirements from customer and market** for existing and planned future technologies, packages, products and services
 + **Define and deploy quality targets for power modules** based on customer, market and application requirements with a strong background in power module package and assembly.
 + Ensure the **fulfillment of time and cost according to agreed qualification plans** and schedules
 + **Develop strategy for product qualification that fit business needs and company quality brand**
 + **Participate in project board reviews and make decisions on project release**
 + **Lead the qualification strategy** along the whole value chain (in house, production partner, material supplier)
 + **Conduct risk assessments** and have decision competence on risk releases under time constraints
 + Initiate and drive **continuous improvement activities** and programs
 + **Act as an interface and build bridges across different functions** i.e. R&D, Marketing, Project management, and Quality Management
 + **Support customer** quality requirements and participate to discussion with key customers
 + Partner with technical teams and operations to **address quality escalations that could affect product quality or customers.**

* **10+ years of professional experience** ideallywithin the semiconductor industry, power module industry and **quality management**

existing_roles.description:
**Corporate Overview**

Aluris Sciences is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 50,000 square feet of manufacturing space. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the life sciences, diagnostics, drug-device, and combination product industries. Aluris is a full-service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions across technical transfer, formulation, filling, lyophilization, assembly, and final kitting of reagents, consumables, and combination products. Aluris provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

**Position Overview**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and managing the company’s quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs. This role ensures that all quality systems align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices, maintaining compliance with ISO-13485, ISO 14971, GMP/GLP, QSR, 21 CFR 820.30, and other relevant medical device (IVD) regulations.

The Director of QA will work closely with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and implement strategic quality initiatives, oversee external audits and regulatory inspections, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This role also involves coaching and mentoring staff, managing compliance metrics, and supporting client engagements by serving as the company’s quality systems representative.

Success in this position requires strong leadership, a deep understanding of quality regulations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build and maintain a culture of compliance and operational excellence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and assist in performing all tasks necessary to achieve the organization's mission and help execute growth
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to formulation and execute the
* strategic vision.
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and actively manage the company's quality system consistent with the culture and intent of the company
* Oversee and coordinate the quality management systems implementation.
* Accountable for maintaining a state of compliance to f CFR 21 820, 210 and 211.
* Act as the "management representative" within the quality plan.
* Will formulate and lead the management team to maintain ISO 13485 compliance.
* Will assist the leadership in implementation of the technology and process capability roadmap with specific emphasis on validation (10/OQ) and documentation support.
* Will be involved in strategic planning, evaluation, and professional development initiatives.
* Will recruit, hire and manage a motivated and highly talented staff of quality and regulatory professionals
* Provide leadership and/or support as needed throughout the organization, specifically all activities associated with bill of materials structuring, part numbering, SKU attributes, set up, training and quality management systems.
* Represent the quality systems acumen and quality systems capabilities of the company.
* Support all clients engagements as the quality system voice of the company and our capabilities
* Will actively work with the VP of Manufacturing to solve challenges in the production environment related to workflow, internal audits, material dispositions (MRP) and process changes/deviations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Successfully served in a similar capacity in a contract manufacturing company for a highly regulated market, preferably the life science/pharmaceutical environment.
* Proven credibility as a Quality leader in the life science manufacturing environment.
* Experience and familiarity in reagent formulation, filling and finishing activities with several years of directly related accountability for quality in this form of manufacturing.
* Proven track record of exceptional performance in these FDA regulated environments with audit experience from the FDA and clients
* FDA rapport and relationships are strongly desired
* A familiarity with Lean Manufacturing cultures in a volume production facility
* Experience and proven results in driving process/technology validation efforts.
* Experience and expertise in communication exchanges with clients during tours, meetings, and audits.
* Consistently exhibited through their actions, decisions, and interactions (internally and externally), the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
* The ability to create, direct and implement corporate objectives in an environment with a high sense of urgency
* A proven capability to generate shareholder value
* Negotiation skills to maximize value in client/regulatory body discussions
* Experience building compliance and standardization of processes (building a scalable organization).
* Experience participating in ERP implementations managing and driving documentation control, bills of materials, routings and workflows.
* A track record of recruiting exceptional talent within the economic constraints of a small company.
* A "hands-on" management style with the interpersonal skills required to build a successful team and the desire to motivate, inspire and develop management team members
* High intelligence with effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and listening skills.
* A proactive style using initiative and perseverance in order to bring about meaningful change.
* Demonstrated high energy.
* Team Player.

**What to Expect:**

This is a full-time, 100% on-site position based in Carlsbad, CA, with a Monday–Friday schedule and 8-hour workdays, excluding meal breaks. Overtime, weekend, and holiday work may be required as business needs arise.

The position offers a flexible start time between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m.; however, employees are expected to maintain a consistent schedule. Any exceptions to the established schedule must be approved in advance by the manager.

**What We Offer/Compensation**

At Aluris Sciences, LLC. we value our employees and are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future. Eligible employees enjoy:

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**Financial & Time Off**

* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid vacation
* California Paid Sick Leave
* Paid company holidays

**Additional Benefits**

* Employee Assistance Program
* Voluntary and supplemental benefit options

The pay range for this position is $195,000 - $205,000 annually. The final compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, education, experience, certifications, and other relevant qualifications.

existing_roles.title: Director, Supplier Industrialization Engineering
existing_roles.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec. This role reports into our VP, Global Supply Chain and brings together two functions that have to move as one: the engineers who industrialize our components and equipment, and the quality systems and team that hold our suppliers accountable once they are producing.

Form's 85% domestically sourced supply chain was built for a battery chemistry with no existing supplier base, which means the industrialization playbook and the quality systems we need are still being written. You will set that standard: rigorous enough to protect a product with a 100-hour duration promise, and practical enough to work with suppliers who are learning our process alongside us. You will fly high enough to set the strategy and the org, and go deep enough to sit in a root cause review when it matters. 
 
*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Lead Form's Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Supplier Quality organization, growing a team of engineers embedded across battery materials, components, and equipment categories.
* Own the end-to-end industrialization journey for direct materials and made-to-spec components, from design-for-manufacturability review and supplier selection through tooling qualification and sustaining production support.
* Build and own Form's supplier quality management system, including PPAP, APQP, PFMEA, control plans, and SCAR/8D corrective action processes, calibrated for a novel battery chemistry with no legacy supply base to borrow from.
* Set the technical bar for supplier selection and qualification, partnering with Global Supply Managers to ensure our sourcing strategy is backed by suppliers who can deliver on cost, quality, and schedule.
* Own supplier process capability and yield performance, coordinating with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to drive root cause analysis and corrective action when issues surface.
* Develop the roadmap and staffing plan for quality systems aligned to relevant standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949) at a scale and stage appropriate to where Form is today and where we are headed.
* Represent supplier technical and quality readiness within the Product Development Process, ensuring every component and supplier is qualified ahead of commercial scale.
* Partner with Supply Chain leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to align supplier roadmaps with Form's build plan and deployment targets.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in supplier industrialization, quality, or manufacturing engineering, including at least 5 years in a people leadership role building and scaling a team.
* Demonstrated expertise across DFM/DFA, PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, and structured root cause methodologies (8D, 5 Whys).
* Experience building quality and industrialization systems from the ground up, ideally in a hardware, energy, or battery environment without an established supplier base to lean on.
* Strong technical fluency to go deep with engineers and suppliers, paired with the executive presence to represent risk, tradeoffs, and strategy to senior leadership.
* Comfort operating across the full arc from early design concept through high-volume production and sustaining support, with the judgment to know which problems need a system and which need a phone call.

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* 
 
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

Compensation Range: $229,950 - $293,835

existing_roles.description:
Join a company where innovation drives growth. At Alloy Precision Technologies, we combine cutting-edge manufacturing, skilled craftsmanship, and a customer-first mindset to deliver industry-leading solutions while providing employees opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Alloy Precision Technologies

 

**SUMMARY:**

To provide strategic, operational, and day-to-day leadership to the manufacturing operations and manufacturing services function at Alloy Precision Technologies (APT) and to grow the business by increased productivity and profitability within a lean environment. Must be a proven leader who is capable of dealing with sometimes complex and difficult situations.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads performance in the planning, coordination, and control of all manufacturing, supply chain, maintenance, production planning, and warehouse functions at APT and the personnel assigned to those functions.
* Establish both quality and efficiency in all production processes to meet performance objectives.
* Promote positive leadership to ensure safety goals and environmental programs for manufacturing operations.
* Direct, monitor, and provide specific feedback on production issues, opportunities, and delays. This will require a proactive approach to investigation and analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution.
* Design and implement on-time tracking systems to monitor manufacturing schedules and operations as necessary to ensure profitability, timely service, and product quality for strong customer service. Provide reports as requested or needed on all aspects of the manufacturing operation.
* Lead the development and implementation of improved operating methods via lean or other strategic manufacturing flow and business process systems and procedures to reduce costs, improve quality performance, and improve profitability.
* Develop effective lines of communication and cooperation between corporate departments and functions within areas of responsibility.
* Promote strong team-building skills. Demonstrate ability to mentor and motivate, as well as to delegate and empower others to succeed.
* Formulate annual operational objectives and programs governing manufacturing, service, and distribution.
* Performs described duties to meet or exceed Customer, AS9100, and regulatory requirements.
* Domestic and international travel may be required.
* Performs other duties assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directly supervises group leaders, supply chain, and production planning. Direct reports may be added or subtracted over time.
* Incumbent will carry out supervisory and managerial responsibilities by following APT organizational policies, applicable federal, state, and local laws. Responsibilities include: interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance: rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints, resolving problems, and career development.

 

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with 10 plus years of manufacturing management experience. Experience in precision welding (tig, laser, brazing, and soldering), CNC and manual machining, and light assembly operations is a plus.
* Incumbent must have strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications. Experience with computer database systems, Visual Manufacturing, and the development of labor standards for cost structure is a plus. Must have a high level of energy, be results-oriented, confident, and have strong people skills. Must be able to establish and maintain a strong rapport and positive relationships with all levels of staff. Must be strategic in his/her orientation, proactive, persistent, and able to handle multiple projects and customers simultaneously, as well as work within a very fast-paced environment.
* Because the company runs at a very fast pace with multiple, rapidly changing priorities, the incumbent must be highly flexible, resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic organization with an evolving culture. Incumbent must enjoy a challenge, be passionate about his/her work, and commit to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing methodologies required, Six Sigma is a plus.

existing_roles.title: Operations Director
existing_roles.description:
At NAES, you’ll find engaging and challenging career opportunities in the power generation, renewable energy and industrial construction industry. At every level of the company, we share a common goal: To instill confidence in our clients through our steadfast commitment to safety, integrity and quality of work.

NAES is the largest independent operator of power facilities in the industry, operating more than 190 power plants throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and the UK that span all technologies and provide over 50 GW of capacity. With the strength of 4000 people, our growing family of companies now addresses the entire life cycle of power generation and other industrial plants.

As the largest independent operator of power facilities in the industry, we’ve come to be viewed as an employer of choice. We strive to attract and retain employees by offering competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package (including retirement) and promotional opportunities.

**Opportunity Summary**

Reporting to a Vice President, Plant Operations, the Operations Director will manage a team of Plant Managers to direct/coordinate NAES support during all phases of plant operations, manage/direct Plant Managers on matters relating to NAES performance in all appropriate areas, policies, procedures, and standards, and ensure that all contractual requirements are met and the maximum value is achieved.

**Here's a look at some of the work you'll be performing:**

* Manage and give direction to all assigned plant personnel responsible for providing support to assigned projects (O&M, Support, or "Third Party" projects as appropriate)
* Provide direction and oversight to assigned Plant Managers on action to meet NAES policies, procedures, contractual requirements and standards
* Manage/oversee coordination with other headquarters departments and NAES subsidiaries to maximize financial returns, achieve optimum project and Division performance in all areas, resolve problems with both internal clients (Plant Managers) AND external clients (Owners/Asset Managers), develop proposals for new projects and support overall Company growth
* Provide strategic and operational leadership for a portfolio of wind and solar renewable energy facilities, ensuring safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective plant performance.
* Lead and support site management teams in achieving operational goals, including generation availability, O&M performance, budgeting, workforce development, environmental compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with customers, asset owners, utilities, contractors, and internal teams to maximize plant performance, manage operational risk, and ensure contractual and regulatory requirements are consistently met.
* Coordinate with and support Marketing and Business Development representatives to identify growth opportunities and execute an integrated approach to fulfill these opportunities. Support the development of proposals for new projects and growth initiatives.
* Manage/oversee maintenance of plant programs to both support and meet NAES performance standards. Ensure plant managers have access to the entire suite of NAES Energy Services resources.
* By continuing assessment and oversight, evaluate plant and project performance in all areas. Identify and implement appropriate actions and follow-up to ensure that the required standards are met.
* Provide periodic reports assessing performance of assigned projects and plants including an assessment of operational and financial performance
* Identify performance shortfalls in any area and recommend or initiate (as appropriate) applicable corrective actions
* Coordinate with Customers - both internal and external - to ensure satisfaction with the services provided
* Manage projects and resources to achieve the maximum client (internal/external) satisfaction
* In coordination with the other NAES subsidiaries, develop "Lessons Learned" "Best Practices" to achieve and maintain the highest level of performance in all areas
* Using all appropriate resources within NAES Energy Services, manage the continuing NAES assessment and evaluation programs. Coordinate with and provide information to all appropriate organizations to achieve continuing performance improvements.
* Based upon the specific situations relevant to the plants and Owners, identify actual and/or potential policy issues; recommend policy revisions as appropriate to NAES Senior Management and, when approved, implement the policies
* Keeping NAES Senior Management appropriately informed, manage customer relations for all assigned plants. Identify and define all support resource requirements, overseeing and coordinating with all applicable organizations. Provide senior day-to-day management of associated physical facilities and Owners.
* In coordination with the Senior Executives, provide management of associated resources and personnel, including Human Resources and Accounting representatives

**NAES Safe**

Safety is a core value of NAES and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to be mentally alert and work safely at all times. Additionally, employees are required to adhere to all safety warnings and posted safety signs whenever on company property. Furthermore, employees must follow all NAES safety rules and procedures. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each employee’s performance.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* The initial starting annual compensation will range from $201,600 to $231,900 based on experience and qualifications.

**Working Relationships**

The Operations Director will report to a Vice President, O&M Services.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions**

This role requires sitting/standing at a desk, using a computer workstation, and the ability to handle long periods of screen time and typing.

Must be available for business hours Monday through Friday. Work is performed on industrial sites when traveling, requiring protective clothing and equipment. Extended hours may be required as a function of meeting customer needs.

**Fitness for Duty**

All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes successful completion of a post-offer drug screen.

**Performance**

All employees have the responsibility to both the customer and their co-workers to do the job right the first time, and to ensure the business needs are being met. NAES evaluates performance throughout the year. Performance reviews are completed on an annual basis.

**Why you’re the perfect addition to our team (about you):**

We are seeking a candidate with exceptional levels of organizational, communication, operational and financial management, assessment, and scheduling skills with proven management skills in an equivalent-level management position.

existing_roles.title: Senior Director - Manufacturing (West Coast & Central Regions)
existing_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Sr Director Manufacturing is responsible for the strategic and operational leadership of multiple chemical manufacturing sites within the **West Coast and Mid-West region** of the US. This role ensures safe, efficient, and compliant operations while driving performance improvements across production, maintenance, EH&S, quality, and supply chain functions. The director will lead site leadership teams, align regional goals with corporate strategy, and foster a culture of operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Travel to the sites will be about 40-65%.**

*The base salary range for this position in as for the job description criteria as listed is $254,000 to $300,000 annually. Our salary ranges are determined by market data based on position and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salaries for that position. Where an individual's pay falls within the range is determined by factors including, but not limited to, location, job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*

*In some cases, compensation may fall outside of this range depending on factors, including a candidate's qualification, skills, competencies, experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Provide oversight and direction to site managers across multiple chemical plants.
* Ensure consistent execution of production plans, maintenance programs, and reliability strategies.
* Monitor and improve KPIs including safety, quality, throughput, cost (FMC & VMC), reliability and environmental performance.
* Lead regional operations reviews and performance benchmarking.

**Safety, Health & Environmental Compliance**

* Champion a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other regulatory bodies.
* Support implementation of Process Safety Management (PSM) and Responsible Care® initiatives.
* Drive incident prevention, emergency preparedness, and environmental stewardship.

**Strategic Planning & Execution**

Align regional operations with corporate goals and long-term strategic plans.

* Lead capital planning and investment prioritization across sites.
* Support new product introductions, technology upgrades, and capacity expansions.

**People Leadership & Development**

* Build and mentor high-performing site leadership teams.
* Promote talent development, succession planning, and workforce engagement.
* Foster collaboration across sites and functions.
* Champion of the Ecovyst SHINE values and Employee Engagement across the region.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Implement Lean, Six Sigma, and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) practices to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) as well as site / unit On Stream Time (OST)
* Drive standardization of best practices across sites.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action programs.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with supply chain, engineering, EH&S, finance, and commercial teams.
* Represent regional operations in executive forums and strategic initiatives.
* Engage with local communities, regulators, and external stakeholders as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Mechanical Engineering; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in chemical manufacturing operations.
* Proven track record of managing multiple sites or large-scale operations.
* Strong knowledge of chemical process technologies, EH&S regulations, and operational excellence frameworks.
* Experience with PSM, ISO standards, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and strategic thinking skills.
* Must be okay with travel

existing_roles.title: Director of Contract Manufacturing
existing_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

**The Director of Contract Manufacturing** focuses activities and resources in the organization around value creation and has responsibility for the success of the value stream. Unlike Steffes’ product-line business units, Contract Manufacturing does not own a product line; it markets and sells Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services, building to customer designs, specifications, and requirements.

The Director of Contract Manufacturing understands key system constraints, quickly identifies critical process issues and successfully maintains key customer relationships. Has management responsibility for the strategy, relationship management, pricing and margin.

This role must have excellent business, manufacturing, and technical knowledge; as well as interpersonal skills to communicate and be an influencer, both internal and external to the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintains responsibility for assigned business unit, including profitability, business development and budgeting.

* Develops sales and promotional strategies for Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services within the Value Stream.

* Sets vision, defines direction, influences and inspires others, aligns and leads teams to create value and grow the business.

* Responsible for increasing and tracking contract manufacturing revenue and market share.

* Responsible for advancing key customer relationships.

* Works with other department leaders to aid in allocation of resources and capacity to achieve specific business results.

* Coaches and assists team members.

* Sets clear expectations for the customer program life cycle, from quote through production and delivery, and ensures the team understands goals and expectations.

* Identifies risks and establishes suitable actions.

* Responsible for overall customer experience and customer care.

* Maintains a deep understanding of Steffes’ engineering and production processes, capabilities, and capacity.

* Ensures accurate and timely technical reviews of customer designs, drawings, and requirements.

* Establishes pricing based on cost estimates and market value such that market share and profitability goals can be met.

* Maintains a good understanding of competing contract manufacturers and engineering service providers, including their capabilities, marketing strategies, and relative costs. Be capable of effectively communicating this information with the sales department and other functional areas.

* Works with account managers to develop strategies to sell Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services to current and prospective customers.

* Ensures Steffes’ contract manufacturing services are competitive from the standpoint of quality, reliability, cost, lead time, and on-time shipping by calling out deficiencies and seeing proper action is initiated to correct problem areas.

* Monthly maintains financial forecasting and price reviews.

* Communicates with internal staff on a regular basis to understand their business problems and help find solutions.

* Maintains a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a collaborative manner with customers, suppliers, co-workers, and management.

* Helps company meet its Strategic, Quality, and Safety objectives.

* Assists with development and execution of annual sales plans.

* Establishes and maintains guidelines for pursuing and accepting new business.

* Daily monitors shipping activity, costing and pricing to ensure sales and profitability goals are being achieved.

* Assists CFO with review of Terms & Conditions and MSA’s and negotiates with the customer to resolve differences.

* Ensures prompt and satisfactory resolution to external quality issues on customer parts and assemblies.

* Other duties may be assigned

**Job Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering or equivalent experience preferred.
* 5 years of experience working in engineering, manufacturing, marketing, or sales
* Experience selling or managing engineering and/or contract manufacturing services with customers.
* Intermediate computer knowledge (Windows, email, internet, etc.)
* Written and verbal communication skills
* Overnight travel is required occasionally

-OR-

* An acceptable combination of education and experience

**Functional & Cognitive Requirements of Position**

* This position requires walking, sitting or standing to a significant degree.
* Must have the ability to lift 50 pounds from floor to waist, carry 50 pounds, and push and/or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Must have the ability to climb ladders and/or stairs.
* Stooping, crouching, kneeling and bending.
* Handling, feeling, and gripping would be required for some activities.
* Visual acuity is required to inspect work completed.
* This role may be subject to internal and external environmental conditions.
* Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

**Core Values:** 
**Trust:** We promote growth and long-term success by making wise decisions with trust as an essential component. 
**Respect:** We unleash creative talents of our diverse workforce by treating each other the way we would like to be treated. 
**Teamwork**: We believe people achieve much more by working together. 
**Integrity:** We follow through and keep our word while being open, honest, ethical, and fair. 
**Safety:** We view our co-workers as family members of our business and strive to ensure safety for all. • Humility: We recognize and appreciate strengths and contributions beyond one’s self. We are modest, genuine, and authentic. 
 
**Core Expectations:** 
**Customer Service** - Demonstrate excellent customer service and display a positive attitude and behavior consistent with the Steffes Code of Conduct and Core Values. 
**Environmental, Health, Safety (EHS)** – Perform work in compliance with EHS training and identified procedures/standard work. Report any EHS incident or concern to your supervisor immediately. Cooperate and contribute to the overall success of the EHS program. 
**Quality** – Participate in job-specific training. Complete work as indicated by standard work, processes, and/or procedures. If your work can’t be completed as required, notify your supervisor immediately for guidance. 
**Conduct** - Demonstrate and support the Steffes Code of Conduct. 
**Policies and Procedures** - Demonstrate and support Steffes Policies and Procedures by: 
o Using tact, sound judgement, and maintaining a professional attitude in communication and relationships with others. 
o Striving to deliver the best quality in daily work. 
o Promoting a positive image of Steffes and its products. 
o Being timely and punctual in attendance and following all policies and procedures.

*Equal Opportunity Employer*

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location**

Carmel, IN • Memphis, TN • St. Louis, MO • Malden, MO • Peoria, IL • Other Illinois locations

**Leadership**

Directly manages at least two quality team members

**Travel**

Regular travel to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed

Weaver Popcorn is seeking a seasoned quality leader ready to step into a broader Director-level role. The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations. This leader will strengthen and standardize quality systems, develop quality talent, and partner with plant and business leaders to ensure products consistently meet company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced food manufacturing quality professional who can set direction while remaining actively engaged with plant teams, audits, investigations, corrective actions, and day-to-day execution.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Quality & Food Safety Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Develop and lead the company’s quality and food safety strategy, priorities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure quality assurance and food safety programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved.
* Establish and oversee grain and popcorn quality standards from grower receipt and bulk storage through processing, bagging, and shipment, ensuring consistent quality controls throughout the supply chain.
* Provide visible leadership on the manufacturing floor through routine plant engagement, risk reviews, verification activities, and follow-up on quality concerns.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.

**SQF, Audits & Regulatory Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and maintain SQF certification programs, including system ownership, audit preparation, certification readiness, corrective actions, and ongoing compliance.
* Plan, lead, and oversee internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits of food manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, and related verification activities.
* Lead cross-functional Food Safety/HACCP, risk assessment, prerequisite program, and food quality teams.
* Monitor applicable food safety and quality requirements and translate them into practical operating standards and controls.
* Ensure effective quality controls for bulk grain storage, bin holds and releases, sampling, testing, and corn disposition prior to processing, including compliance with applicable phytosanitary requirements.

**Quality Management Systems**
------------------------------

* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.
* Standardize quality documentation, specifications, procedures, policies, records, and reporting across facilities.
* Use quality data, trend analysis, and leading and lagging indicators to identify risk, establish priorities, and improve performance.
* Ensure effective controls for ingredient sampling, product verification, environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, traceability, and other core quality programs.
* Provide oversight of corn testing and laboratory quality programs, including mycotoxin testing, internal and third-party sample testing, review of test results, and appropriate product disposition based on quality and food safety requirements.

**People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a quality team of at least two direct reports, with potential for broader team responsibility as the function grows.
* Set clear goals, define accountabilities, assess performance, strengthen technical capability, and create development plans for quality team members.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Operations leaders to resolve quality issues without compromising food safety, customer requirements, or regulatory compliance.
* Establish and enforce hold/release and product disposition standards, with authority to stop processing or bagging operations and place grain, ingredients, or finished product on hold when food safety or quality requirements are not met.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Service to respond to customer documentation requests, audits, samples, complaints, and quality-related inquiries.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Oversee nonconforming material, product holds, rework, release, and disposition processes, partnering with Operations and suppliers to ensure timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear quality updates, risk assessments, recommendations, and performance reporting to senior leadership and other decision-makers.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor's degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or related fields.
* 8–10+ years of progressive quality or food safety experience in the food manufacturing industry.
* At least 5 years of people-management experience, including progressive supervisory and manager-level responsibility.
* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Consistent audit and certification readiness across facilities.
* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**
===============================

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Quality must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when operational, audit, customer, or food safety needs require support. Regular travel is expected based on business needs.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document*

existing_roles.title: Aerospace Quality Director
existing_roles.description:
*Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

Neon is looking for an Aerospace Quality Director to help build the quality systems, team, and operating discipline needed to take parts and assemblies from prototype into production. This role will lead the quality function across development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production readiness, ensuring the company can scale with strong process control, repeatability, and compliance. You will play a key role in helping a growing aerospace organization move from fast iteration to reliable production without losing technical rigor.

### **Why This Role Matters**

* Help shape how a growing company scales from prototype builds to stable production.
* Build the quality foundation needed for repeatable manufacturing, stronger yields, and fewer escapes.
* Partner directly with engineering and manufacturing to improve design transfer, process readiness, and production execution.
* Lead the systems and team that drive inspection discipline, nonconformance control, corrective action, and supplier quality.
* Influence how production processes are defined, controlled, and improved as volume and complexity grow.
* Operate in a fast-paced environment where quality decisions directly affect hardware readiness, customer confidence, and operational scale.
* Work across office, lab, and production settings with direct visibility into how quality impacts the business.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, aerospace, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience managing a growing department of direct reports responsible for all aspects of product and process quality.
* Significant progressive experience in aerospace quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, or quality systems leadership.

existing_roles.title: Plant/Manufacturing Director
existing_roles.description:
Job Summary
 
Maker’s Pride is seeking a proven, enterprise-minded Plant Director to lead our largest manufacturing facility in McComb, Ohio, a site of more than 1,600 Team Members that is critical to the success of our business. The Plant Director holds full accountability for the safety, quality, service, cost, and people performance of a large-scale co-manufacturing operation, and serves as the senior leader on site and the face of the plant to customers, Team Members, and the community.
 
This role requires a seasoned operations executive who has led large, complex plants of 1,000+ Team Members, can build and develop a strong leadership bench, and can balance day-to-day execution with long-term strategy. The Plant Director partners closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver the plant’s operating plan, drive operational excellence, and position McComb for sustained growth.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Operational Leadership: Lead all plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehouse, and supply chain, to consistently deliver safety, quality, service, and cost targets across multiple shifts and lines.
* P&L and Financial Accountability: Own the plant’s operating plan, budget, and financial performance, including labor, overtime, yield, waste, and capital spend. Identify and execute cost-reduction and margin-improvement opportunities.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and execute a multi-year plant strategy aligned to enterprise goals, covering capacity, capital investment, automation, new business onboarding, and talent.
* Production Planning and Capacity: Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, and Customer teams to build production schedules and resource plans that optimize throughput, labor utilization, and on-time, in-full performance.
* Quality and Food Safety: Ensure strict adherence to quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, GMP, HACCP, and customer and third-party audit standards). Drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain audit readiness at all times.
* Safety Culture: Champion a zero-harm culture. Enforce safety policies, lead regular audits and incident reviews, and hold the leadership team accountable for proactive hazard prevention and compliance.
* Workforce Strategy and Labor Relations: Partner with HR to attract, retain, and engage a large and diverse workforce. Drive staffing stability, reduce turnover, manage overtime effectively, and foster positive Team Member and labor relations, including compliance with applicable employment and labor laws and agreements.
* Customer and Partner Relationships: Serve as the senior site representative with co-manufacturing customers, hosting visits and audits, resolving escalations, and building long-term trust. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead a data-driven operational excellence program using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to eliminate waste, improve OEE and yield, and standardize best practices across shifts.
* Capital and Asset Management: Oversee capital planning, project execution, and asset reliability to ensure equipment, infrastructure, and facilities support safe, efficient, and scalable operations.
* Reporting and Executive Communication: Provide regular, transparent reporting on safety, quality, production, financial, and workforce KPIs to senior leadership, with clear analysis, risks, and recommendations.
* Community and Site Presence: Represent Maker’s Pride in the McComb community and maintain a visible, accessible leadership presence on the plant floor across all shifts.

Supervisory Responsibilities
 

* Leadership of a Large Organization: Provide direct leadership to the plant leadership team and overall leadership of 1,600+ Team Members, including managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff.
* Talent Development: Build a strong leadership bench through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of high-potential leaders.
* Culture and Accountability: Foster a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, respect, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications
 

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 7+ years in a senior plant leadership role (Plant Manager, Plant Director, or equivalent).
* Scale: Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multi-shift plants of 1,000+ Team Members, with full P&L accountability.
* Industry: Experience in co-manufacturing, food, beverage, or other high-volume, regulated manufacturing environments strongly preferred.
* Operational Excellence: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost. Lean, Six Sigma, or similar certification desirable.
* Workforce Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop a large, diverse workforce, including strong experience with staffing, retention, and employee and labor relations. Experience in a unionized environment is a plus.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, food safety and quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Technology: Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with manufacturing software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.
* Leadership Skills: Strategic thinker with excellent executive presence, communication, and decision-making skills; able to influence at all levels of the organization and with customers.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

The information provided in this document provides an overview of the most common duties, qualifications, and demands of the position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive summary of the role, and the duties, qualifications, and demands of the position are subject to change without notice. The expectations provided here may also be modified if an employee with a disability could effectively meet the expectations for the role with reasonable accommodation.

existing_roles.title: Director, Site Manufacturing Controller
existing_roles.description:
Reporting to the SVP and CFO for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality, the Director, Site Manufacturing Controller serves as the senior finance leader and strategic business partner for the Salt Lake City manufacturing site. This role provides enterprise-level financial leadership across site operations, translating manufacturing performance, capacity, productivity, quality, inventory, and capital investment drivers into clear business insights and actions. The Director advises site and functional leadership, challenges operating and investment assumptions, leads long-range financial planning, and drives sustainable improvement in manufacturing cost, working capital, and capital efficiency. The role is accountable for the integrity of site financial results, product costing, forecasting, internal controls, and decision support in alignment with company policies and applicable accounting standards. The Director leads and develops the local manufacturing controlling team and connects the Salt Lake City site with regional, global, and corporate finance stakeholders.

**Primary Duties**
------------------

* **Strategic finance leadership and business partnership:** Act as the senior finance advisor to Salt Lake City site leadership and a key member of the site leadership team. Shape site strategy, operating priorities, and resource allocation by translating business and manufacturing drivers into financial implications, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* **Site performance and value creation:** Own the financial performance framework for the site, including profit and loss, cost of goods, manufacturing variances, productivity, yield, scrap, labor and overhead, fixed-cost absorption, inventory, and working capital. Establish performance routines, identify root causes, and hold leaders accountable for corrective actions and measurable value delivery.
* **Long-range planning, budgeting, and forecasting:** Lead the site financial planning cycle, including strategic plans, annual budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis. Ensure plans reflect realistic assumptions for volume, mix, capacity, headcount, compensation, inflation, productivity, and supply constraints.
* **Capital investment and portfolio governance:** Provide financial leadership for major capital investments, capacity expansion, automation, digitalization, facility improvements, and cost-reduction programs. Set standards for business cases, challenge assumptions, recommend priorities, assess risk and return, and oversee post-investment benefit tracking.
* **Product costing and inventory governance:** Direct site product costing, standard cost development, inventory valuation, cycle counts, physical inventory, excess and obsolete inventory analysis, and cost improvement tracking. Partner with global finance and operations to strengthen costing accuracy and harmonize practices across the manufacturing network.
* **Financial close, reporting, and executive communication:** Oversee accurate and timely month-end and year-end close activities for the site. Deliver concise, decision-oriented reporting and executive commentary that explains results, outlook, key risks, opportunities, and required actions to site, regional, and global leaders.
* **Controls, compliance, and audit readiness:** Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with company financial policies, applicable accounting requirements, and audit standards. Lead remediation of internal and external audit findings, strengthen financial governance, and proactively address control or compliance risks.
* **Cross-functional and global influence:** Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Human Resources, Information Systems, and Corporate Finance. Represent the Salt Lake City site in regional and global finance forums and influence standards, priorities, and decisions beyond the local organization.
* **Transformation and continuous improvement:** Sponsor and lead improvements in financial processes, management reporting, data quality, analytics, systems, and operating rhythms. Use lean thinking, automation, and standardized tools to improve speed, insight, control, and efficiency.
* **Organization leadership and talent development:** Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing site controlling team. Set clear expectations, build succession and capability plans, allocate resources, and create an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, sound judgment, and continuous improvement.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

* Direct supervision: 1-5 employees.

**Required Education, Training and Experience**
-----------------------------------------------

* Bachelor degree required in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics
* 10+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or controlling experience

**Preferred Education, Training and Experience**
------------------------------------------------

* Experience supporting a complex manufacturing or supply chain environment
* Master of Business Administration, master's degree in a related discipline, Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, or equivalent professional certification preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading, developing, and retaining high-performing finance professionals.
* Experience in audit, internal audit, operational management control
* Experience in an international environment is a plus

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Effective Presentation Skills - including the ability to present technical data
* Analyze data and make decisions/recommendations, using data to guide decision-making and provide suggestions for improvement.
* Business acumen to understand how a business operates and how to make it successful.
* Effectively deal with ambiguity requiring adaptability, critical thinking, and proactive communication to navigate situations with limited details
* Thriving in a fast-paced environment by managing tasks, multitasking, and adapting quickly to maintain productivity.
* Skilled in MS Office tools to include but not limited to Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
 + Advanced: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently
* Accounting and controlling skills, and day to day use of ERP (SAP is a must, S/Hana is a plus)
* Analytical and synthesizing capabilities

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

* Domestic travel: **5%**
* International travel: **5%**
* Total travel: **10%**

The estimated salary range for this role based in Utah is between $150,000 – 210,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMerieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options
* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance
* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.
* Adoption Assistance
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Commuter Benefits
* Various voluntary benefit offerings
* Discount programs
* Parental leaves

existing_roles.description:
**Lassonde Pappas & Co.** is a US Leader in beverage manufacturing dedicated to our team members, customers and consumers satisfaction. We remain committed to our small-town roots and rural values. **Hardworking** and **caring** are qualities that make our teams special. Since 1942, we’ve been producing delicious products for our customers across the country!

To provide the best for our customers, we focus on building the best team by creating and advancing an inclusive environment amongst our diverse workforces. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, reliable, and committed to being and doing better, join us!

**We value each of our employees’ total wellbeing. To support employees in all stages of their wellness journey, we have a robust benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage options, growth and development potential, along with 401-K, Life & Disability Insurance, PTO, Tuition Reimbursement, Health Fairs, Gym Membership Discounts, and so much more!**

*Pay Range for this position is: $155,000-$200,000 plus annual bonus, depending on experience and geographical location.*

**POSITION SUMMARY** 
The Environmental Health and Safety Director leads the development, implementation, and performance of health, safety, and environmental programs and policies at Lassonde Pappas & Co. Inc. facilities, to maintain compliance with applicable national and local regulations and to ensure a safe, healthy working environment for all employees. This role reports to the VP of Manufacturing for the US and is based out of our Cherry Hill, New Jersey location.

**Primary Responsibilities include*****:***

* Oversee and ensure the organization’s compliance with local, state, and federal environment, health, and safety regulations including (but not limited to) fire safety and OSHA regulations, and keep up with any changes to laws and regulations that impact the organization
* Work closely with the organization’s legal department to ensure that the company is in compliance with these regulations
* Direct audits and work with each plant and its departments to ensure that all company guidelines are being followed
* Manage the safety budget at the manufacturing sites to ensure that appropriate personal protective and safety equipment is available as needed to prevent injuries and provide for a safe and healthy work environment
* Develop, implement, and evaluate programs, policies, and procedures related to health, safety, and environmental issues in the workplace, and ensure that environmental policy and procedure manuals are available and updated at all times to reduce the risk of injury or illness in the workplace
* Prepare, schedule, and execute training to cover emergency procedures, workplace safety, and other relevant topics
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring and continuous improvement of environmental health and safety programs
* Conduct risk assessments of work sites to identify potential hazards and formulate plans to mitigate them
* Coordinate with insurance carriers to ensure that appropriate coverage is in place to cover any potential risks
* Review the employee accident reports and medical claims to evaluate the need for potential changes to current policies or procedures
* Consult with engineers to ensure that building designs are safe and compliant with current regulations
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain staff by training employees; maintaining a safe, secure, and legal work environment; developing personal growth opportunities.
* Set objectives, monitor performance, and develop individual training plans to support professional development

* Communicate job expectations; planning, monitoring, and assessing job results; coaching, and counseling employees; developing, coordinating, and enforcing systems, procedures, and productivity standards.
* Establish strategic goals; identifying and evaluating trends; choosing a course of action; defining objectives; evaluating outcomes.
* Set strategic direction and coordinate the work of others to achieve objectives.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Safety, Occupational Safety and Health, or related field required; Masters degree desirable.

* Minimum 8 years working experience in Supply Chain environment in Food and Beverage or other perishable goods
* 5+ years of safety and environmental experience in a manufacturing environment. Experience with a union manufacturing environment is a plus.
* Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to influence others while maintaining professionalism
* Proficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook (knowledge in Excel should extend past spreadsheet manipulation and should include creation of formulas)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Detailed oriented and can multi-task
* Excellent time management skills

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the food/beverage industry
* Experience in Manufacturing or production environment
* Experience with risk management and project management
* Must pay high attention to detail and have strong interpersonal, communication, and observation skills
* Experience in report writing
* Proven organizational skills
* Ability to direct, coach, and train others
* Consultative, influential, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS**

This position requires sufficient physical ability to work in a typical office setting; driving a motor vehicle and occasionally working in the field/production setting.

**FREQUENT:** sitting, upward and downward flexion of neck; fine finger dexterity and light to moderate finger pressure to include extended periods of keyboard and mouse use, side-to-side turning of neck, walking, standing, bending and stooping, pushing/pulling, twisting at waist, moderate wrist torque to twist equipment knobs and dials.

**OCCASIONAL:** squatting, kneeling, reach above and at shoulder height, moderate grasp to manipulate reference books and manuals; lifting objects weighing 20 – 35 lbs. from below waist to above shoulders and transporting distances up to 50 feet.

**VISION:** Ability to see in the normal visual range with or without correction.

**HEARING:** Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without correction.

Other duties as assigned are part of every job description. existing_roles.description:
**Department:** Operations **Job Status:** Full Time

**FLSA Status:** Exempt **Reports To:** President

**Job Type:** Non-Union **Amount of Travel Required:** Occasional

**Work Schedule:** Monday – Friday

Evenings, weekends, Holidays as needed. **Positions Supervised:** Production Staff

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director of Manufacturing executes the company operating plan within capital and operating budget parameters. The Director of Manufacturing works with the executive leadership team to develop strategies and objectives to maximize productivity and profitability. Analyzes production trends, forecasts future requirements, solve problems, motivates & develops employees.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Essential Functions Statement(s)**

 

* Improve operational efficiencies to reduce total production costs while meeting specific product volume needs
* Check and verify production records, handle questions or concerns of inventory shortages or overages and address problems with inventory control.
* Coordinate production schedules to meet sales demand. Adjust production as necessary to meet seasonal demands ahead of schedule.
* Ensure consistency in collective bargaining agreement and provide support during contract negotiations
* Effect necessary communication and motivation to staff. Monitors individual performance via observation and review of various productivity measures. Counsels and disciplines as necessary.
* Provides production required safety leadership and training and is responsible for improved safety performance
* Oversees all production planning and executing against demand signals.
* Oversees facility maintenance team, including Cap-Ex planning and execution.
* Provides input on new product development.
* Ensure compliance with all appropriate health and food safety regulations and cleanliness, including audit preparation
* Manage customer complaint process.
* OSHA, Federal and State requirements are followed with the facility and equipment.
* Attends the Executive, Senior Management, and Safety Committee Meetings
* Maintain work area in a neat, orderly and sanitary manner.
* Correctly and promptly follow specified company procedures required for the appropriate handling of all.
* Emergency Responses and Safety practices.

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

**Competency Statement(s)**

* Communication, Written – Ability to communicate in writing clearly and concisely.
* Collaboration - Collaborates positively to effectively build relationships with customers and co-workers to achieve company objectives and contribute to overall organizational success. Works effectively within a diverse environment. Exhibits a positive attitude and contributes to overall team success.
* Organized – Being organized or following a systematic method of performing a task.
* Communication, Oral – Ability to communicate effectively with others using the spoken word.
* Responsible – Ability to be held accountable or answerable for one’s conduct.
* Honesty / Integrity – Ability to be truthful and be seen as credible in the workplace.
* Accountability – Ability to accept responsibility and account for his/her actions.
* Reliability – The trait of being dependable and trustworthy.
* Friendly – Ability to exhibit a cheerful demeanor toward others.
* Customer Oriented – Ability to take care of the customer’s needs while following company procedures.

**Mental Demands:**

* Ability to work under stressful conditions
* Able to interact with others with courtesy and tact
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects in an organized and efficient manner
* Ability to respond to crisis situations in a calm and effective manner
* Ability to complete projects on schedule

**Communication Demands:**

The position requires talking to co-workers, customers, vendors; requires written communications to and from co-workers, customers and vendors, talking on the telephone; requires responding to written or verbal requests of co-workers, customers and vendors; requires training/giving verbal and written instructions; requires receiving verbal and written instructions; requires writing/composing written language; requires reading; requires visiting/working at other work-sites; Ability to communicate via the latest technologies required for the position.
