existing_roles.title: Director of Program Management, Manufacturing
existing_roles.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

KRUSH Tech is an international technology company developing advanced hardware solutions for defense, aerospace, communications, and autonomous systems. We're launching our U.S. operations from the ground up, building a next-generation, vertically integrated aerospace organization focused on advanced uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS), autonomy, and sensing technologies for the U.S. market and strategic partners. Our teams work across RF, embedded systems, electronics, mechanical engineering, software, manufacturing, and supply chain to turn some of the industry's most demanding engineering challenges into reliable, production-ready solutions, combining the agility of a startup with the ambition to compete at the leading edge of UAS and autonomous systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Director of Program Management to lead program delivery for KRUSH's uncrewed aircraft systems, from development through production and fielding. This senior leadership role owns cost, schedule, and technical delivery performance across a portfolio of cross-functional programs, aligns engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test around clear milestones, and serves as the point of accountability for customers and partners.

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations, you will build program management discipline in a start-up U.S. operation: light enough to move fast, and rigorous enough to meet customer commitments. You will partner closely with engineering and manufacturing leaders to take products from concept through production ramp, balancing competing priorities, risks, and resources across programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own cost, schedule, scope, and technical delivery performance across a portfolio of programs, from development through production and fielding
* Develop and implement program management strategy, governance, and standards, using lightweight processes and tools that fit a fast-moving start-up
* Ensure programs align with corporate objectives and strategic priorities, and lead portfolio reviews that prioritize initiatives by business value and strategic impact
* Build, lead, and develop the program management team as the organization grows, including career development and succession planning
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Test leaders to drive decisions, manage dependencies, and resolve issues across functions
* Lead the transition of programs from development into production, including readiness reviews and stage-gate decisions
* Manage portfolio resource allocation, monitor program performance and interdependencies, and balance competing priorities
* Serve as the primary interface with customers, executive leadership, and external partners, communicating program status, risks, opportunities, and outcomes, and facilitating steering committees and executive reviews
* Develop and manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor financial performance, evaluate business cases and return on investment, and support annual planning and investment prioritization
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks and issues, and develop contingency plans for critical risks
* Lead change management and organizational readiness activities for program changes
* Ensure compliance with governance, regulatory, export control, and contractual requirements
* Implement program and portfolio management tools and reporting systems, and define and track program KPIs, including on-time milestone achievement, budget adherence, resource utilization, and risk mitigation effectiveness
* Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and delivery excellence

 **Requirements**

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* 10+ years of program and project management experience, preferably in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability hardware
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing large programs or a PMO function
* Experience leading cross-functional, hardware-intensive programs from development through production
* Experience managing programs under customer or government contracts, including cost, schedule, and deliverable performance
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and to influence executive stakeholders
* Strong skills in program and portfolio management, strategic planning, financial and budget management, risk and issue management, change management, and resource planning
* Strong data analysis and executive reporting skills, with experience in business process improvement
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and influencing skills
* Active U.S. Secret security clearance, with the ability to maintain it
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time
* Must qualify as a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities (ITAR)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Master's degree (MBA or equivalent)
* Familiarity with defense contracting and acquisition processes, including FAR/DFARS, contract types, CDRLs, and earned value management
* Experience building a program management function or PMO at a start-up or high-growth company
* PMP or an equivalent program management certification

 **Benefits**

KRUSH Tech offers a competitive compensation package. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual offers are determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on interview performance, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, and internal equity.

The salary range provided is a good faith estimate of the applicable range as of the date of posting. The final offer will be determined after considering all relevant factors, including a candidate's qualifications and experience.

In addition to base pay, KRUSH Tech offers a monthly benefits stipend that employees can apply toward the health, dental, vision, or other coverage that best fits their needs, along with 9 paid federal holidays per year.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

KRUSH Tech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

KRUSH Tech is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Human Resources.

**Department**: Operations

**Reports** **to**: COO

**Responsibilities:**

* Assures production levels are maintained safely to schedule.
* Closely monitors all areas of production to ensure work is carried out to the highest standards.
* Assist staff on site in responding to any technical and/or staffing issues.
* Alters production in accordance with materials required.
* Manages the production process by setting and monitoring performance targets.
* Manages and regulates the budget.
* Provides information and updates on performance to senior managers as requested.
* Maintains up-to-date records to include inventory, inspection systems, checklists, and financials.
* Keeps abreast of key government health, safety, and environmental regulations, assuring they are implemented throughout the operation.
* Conducts regular site inspections to ensure compliance.
* Assesses equipment, orders new materials as required, and coordinates with internal and external maintenance to address plant and equipment readiness. Ensures all vehicles on site are maintained to a good standard.
* Provides training and development opportunities and works with the team to create development plans.

**Requirements:**

* The facility operates 24 hours a day / 7 days a week. The ability to respond outside of normal business hours is required.
* Ability to work a flexible shift when needed to include days, evenings, nights, and weekends.
* Regular and predictable attendance.
* Pre-employment screening, including drug screening and background check.
* 3+ years of supervision experience working in a manufacturing environment.
* Degree in Engineering or Science.
* Experience with change management.
* Previous use of a planned maintenance system.
* Experience with PLCs and automation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical, leadership, and organizational skills.
* Proficient in MS Office Suite.

**Skills:**

* Results Driven: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* Cultivate Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the Company to be successful
* Attracts & Develops talent: Attracting and selecting the best talent to meet current and future business needs. Develop people to meet both their career goals and the Company's goals.
* Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a strong focus on continuous improvement.

Leadership experience in a manufacturing or similar environment

existing_roles.description:
Overview:

**WHO WE ARE**

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. 
 
Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

**TOTAL REWARDS**

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $189,000 to $210,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Responsibilities:

**PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION**

Manage and oversee the safe, efficient and reliable operation of fossil or hydro station(s). Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements, applicable industry technical standards and company policies. Operate the plant(s) in a manner that minimizes the cost of generation and maximizes profitability while maintaining the long-term viability of the station assets.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

 

* Ensure standards are established and implemented to provide a safe work environment.
* Effectively manage all resources to ensure generation of electricity in a timely and reliable manner at the direction of the Power Team.
* Maintain a positive work environment and good employee relations. Provide guidance for employee development opportunities and timely feedback regarding performance.
* Serve as a change agent for business initiatives, while assuring the human element is understood and considered
* Manage the station O&M and capital budgets to minimize costs and maximize profitability while ensuring the long-term viability of the assets.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements and maintain environmental stewardship.
* Maintain effective community relations to promote a positive image of the Company.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* BS in engineering or business
* Minimum of 10 years professional experience
* Minimum of 8 years power plant (or related) experience
* Minimum of 5 years supervisory/managerial experience
* Professional or technical level experience in a technical role at a power plant
* Operations
* At least 2 of the following: Corporate/Staff, Engineering, Maintenance, or Outage
* Leadership assessment required

 
Qualifications:

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

 

* Master's Degree in engineering, business or related field
* Multi-site experience
* Multi-departmental experience
* Collective bargaining experience

Description:

Davis Furniture is a family-owned high-end furniture manufacturer who is a leader in contemporary contract furniture. We have been in business for over 80 years, and we put a strong focus on new product introductions because design is a choice. Business at Davis is thriving! We are currently looking to hire a new Plant Manager for one of our plants.

Requirements:

The Plant Manager is the primary resource for all plant functions in area of responsibility. Manages both supervisors and hourly employees; and interacts with support personnel to ensure all established key metrics are achieved. Responsible for ensuring all company policy and procedures are followed, driving continuous improvement initiatives, enforcing safety policies and procedures, and ensuring that quality is maintained to Davis and customer standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all manufacturing processes
* Ensure production schedules, output goals, and quality standards are consistently met
* Monitor workflow, labor utilization, and process efficiency
* Identify and resolve production issues while driving continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors and department managers
* Manage hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and engagement
* Enforce safety policies and ensure OSHA compliance
* Lead safety initiatives to reduce workplace incidents
* Ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements
* Manage labor, materials, and operational costs
* Track and analyze key performance metrics (efficiency, scrap, downtime, throughput)
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and improve overall plant performance
* Oversee preventative maintenance and equipment reliability
* Coordinate repairs and capital improvements
* Partner with purchasing and planning to maintain proper inventory levels and ensure material availability
* Other duties may be added as required\*

**Education/Experience**

* Must be 18 years of age
* Associate's or Bachelor's in Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five years of manufacturing leadership experience, preferably in furniture, upholstery, textile, or related manufacturing environments.
* Previous experience managing sewing, cutting, upholstery, or similar production operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supervisors and production employees.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production scheduling, labor management, and quality control.
* Understanding of fabric handling, cutting methods, patterns, sewing operations, and material utilization.
* Experience with production metrics, cost management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to make operational decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Benefits:**

Weekly pay

401(k)

Profit Sharing

Excellent health insurance with low deductible

Dental and vision plans

Voluntary and Company paid Life insurance

Short term/Long-term disability

Referral program

Paid holidays

On-site Clinic

Schedule:

This is a first shift salaried position; you will work Monday-Friday and Saturdays as needed.

Davis provides an excellent, drug free working environment and is an EEO/AA employer.

Please visit our website for more insight into our company and the products we create. www.davisfurniture.com

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:30 am - 5:00 pm**

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and performance of the Data-Graphics manufacturing facility. This position directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, safety, maintenance, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Plant Manager ensures production commitments are met while maintaining high quality standards, maximizing operational efficiency, controlling costs, and fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and safety.

The Plant Manager provides strategic and hands-on leadership to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs), customer satisfaction goals, employee engagement objectives, and business growth initiatives.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**Operations Management**

* Direct and oversee all day-to-day plant operations, including production, scheduling, quality, safety, maintenance and receiving activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality standards, delivery commitments, and operational efficiency.
* Develop, monitor, and achieve plant performance metrics related to productivity, quality, waste reduction, safety, downtime, labor utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales, customer service, prepress, and production teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establish priorities and allocate resources to support production requirements and business objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed to improve productivity and profitability.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, and production personnel to maximize performance and engagement.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, professionalism, and employee development.
* Conduct performance evaluations, establish performance expectations, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations matters, recruitment, retention, performance management, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training and development opportunities to support operational excellence.

**Quality Management**

* Champion quality initiatives to ensure products consistently meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Investigate quality concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Monitor production processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and defect reduction.
* Work closely with client services and suppliers to address quality-related concerns and maintain strong business relationships.

**Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Promote and maintain a safe work environment through training, audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and support accident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is utilized and safety procedures are consistently followed.

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee preventive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives throughout the facility.
* Evaluate equipment, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve throughput, reduce spoilage, and optimize labor utilization.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operational expenses.
* Monitor labor costs, production costs, and capital expenditures to ensure financial targets are achieved.
* Participate in forecasting, strategic planning, and capital investment decisions affecting the facility.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Communicate operational results, goals, and key initiatives to leadership and employees.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance, production metrics, quality trends, safety performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Keep executive management informed of significant operational issues, risks, and opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of company objectives.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

Are you a proven leader who thrives on building strong teams and delivering exceptional service? At SRM Concrete, our Plant Managers are the driving force behind our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction. As a Plant Manager, you’ll lead by example—empowering your team, optimizing daily operations, and ensuring every load meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and service.

If you’re passionate about leadership, logistics, and making a positive impact in your community, this is your opportunity to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and growth.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* Inspirational leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or plant operations—experience in the concrete or construction industry is highly valued.
* Proficiency with dispatch software, Microsoft Office Suite, and a willingness to learn new systems.
* Knowledge of DOT regulations and safety standards for transportation and delivery.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; you build trust with team members, customers, and partners.
* Dedication to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Systems
existing_roles.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Greendale, Indiana site is a key part of the company’s Wellness business, serving as one of North America’s primary gummy development and manufacturing centers. The site specializes in the formulation and production of traditional gelatin gummies and 100% plant‑based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceutical applications, supporting a wide range of consumer health products. With strong in‑house R&D, quality laboratories, and flexible manufacturing and packaging capabilities, the Greendale operation partners closely with customers to develop innovative, high‑quality, and consumer‑friendly gummy delivery formats across a variety of flavors, shapes, and functional ingredients, all produced under rigorous quality and food‑safety standards.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager, Quality Systems to join our team and lead the Quality and Compliance functions at the Catalent Greendale site. This role oversees a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and release. The position ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations while driving continuous improvement across the Quality organization. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to maintain product integrity and ensure the consistent delivery of high‑quality products to our customers.

Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM 
Location: Greendale, IN 
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Oversee Quality and Compliance functions related to dietary supplement manufacturing at the Catalent Greendale site.
* Lead a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and product release.
* Review and approve manufacturing and packaging change controls, product formulations, label changes, deviations, corrective and preventive action plans, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, NSF, and SQF requirements for product manufacturing and participate in internal and external audits.
* Develop and maintain quality and compliance policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to product quality and oversee root cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Lead the Food Safety Team and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 110 and 117, HACCP Food Safety, and Food Defense Plans.
* Monitor the sanitary state of the facility and equipment to ensure cross‑contamination control.
* Collaborate with Operations to assess the effectiveness of sanitation programs and ensure compliance with food safety guidelines.
* Maintain a feedback loop with Customer Service to address quality issues affecting product release.
* Oversee training programs to educate staff on quality standards and compliance requirements.
* Establish and track key performance indicators to measure quality and compliance performance.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain teams to integrate quality into all production processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on quality and compliance matters.
* Oversee investigations, environmental monitoring, and critical control point incidents impacting product release.
* Support site management in enforcing current Good Manufacturing Practices and mentoring staff in compliance.
* Facilitate internal assessments, compliance meetings, and training sessions.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in science or related field (Chemistry, Microbiology, or Biology) and at least five years of pharmaceutical and dietary supplement quality experience.
* Minimum of seven years of related experience, including three to four years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in current Good Manufacturing Practice compliance and working in a quality role within the pharmaceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines. The individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds; no lifting greater than 44.09 pounds without assistance. Must be accessible to the manufacturing floor and office staff and use required office equipment. Specific vision requirements include reading written documents and frequent use of a computer monitor.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Experience with investigation writing, including root cause analysis and report preparation for annual product reviews.
* Familiarity with regulations 21 CFR 111, 21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 211, GFSI, HACCP, Preventive Controls Qualified Individual, SQF, NSF, and UL certifications.
* Experience with electronic systems such as JDE, TrackWise, Electronic Document Management System, Learning Management System, Quality Management System, Veeva, Compliance Wire, and Stability Programs.
* Experience communicating with FDA inspectors or other regulatory agents and handling FDA 483 responses.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve quality systems.

**Why You Should Join Catalent**
--------------------------------

* Positive and fast‑paced working environment focusing on continually improving processes to remain innovative and dynamic.
* Competitive Paid Time Off plus eight paid holidays.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment.
* Tuition Reimbursement – support to complete or earn a new degree.
* Site‑based Employee Engagement activities such as End‑of‑Summer and NFL kickoff celebrations, March Madness tournament, Summer Food Truck Fridays, Veterans Appreciation Lunch, Homemade Chili Cook‑off, Salsa Competition, Ice Cream Sundae Bar, and more.
* Employee Resource Groups focusing on Diversity and Inclusion.
* Environmentally friendly, community engagement green initiatives.
* Defined career path and annual performance review process with potential for career growth on an expanding team.
* WellHub program promoting overall physical and mental wellness.
* Perkspot offering exclusive discounts from over 900 merchants across various categories.

**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

existing_roles.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Senior Manager Quality Compliance**

**Working at Abbott** 
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity** 
This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the **Senior Manager Quality Compliance**, you’ll provide leadership for quality system compliance initiatives, audit readiness, regulatory change management, field actions, and quality compliance strategy across the EP business. This role leads teams and collaborates across functions to strengthen compliance capabilities, support inspections and audits, and drive continuous improvement

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead quality compliance programs, including external audit support, inspection readiness activities, and quality system effectiveness initiatives.
* Develop and execute compliance strategies for the EP business, strengthening audit capability across sites and functions.
* Manage and support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), RRE/SRE, field action, and remediation activities to ensure timely and compliant execution.
* Assess industry trends, regulatory changes, and standards updates, implementing solutions that advance organizational compliance.
* Lead and mentor team members while partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives.

Quality Management Systems/Compliance

* Support life cycle of external audits (ie. execution, preparation, completion, etc).
* Drive site audit readiness for FDA & NB
* Expand compliance capabilities to support IA
* Support Certificate Management and Finance Portfolio Management
* Manage HHE and Field Action Program
* Impact Analysis on Industry Trends
* Manage Field Action Strategy, as appropriate
* As needed, support regulation and standards change assessment

People Management & Strategy

* Lead diverse team to achieve compliance goals
* Develop compliance strategy for EP BU
* Develop audit capability across EP sites and functions
* Demonstrate Compliance Expertise through Leadership Behaviors

Lead Strategic Quality & Compliance Programs

* Develop and execute global quality and compliance strategies that align with divisional priorities and long-term business objectives.
* Build and manage program roadmaps, business cases, budgets, funding requests, and implementation plans for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Establish meaningful partnerships across Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial organizations to drive successful program execution.
* Present program strategies, progress updates, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Strengthen Audit Readiness & Inspection Success

* Lead and support the lifecycle of external audits, including preparation, execution, response management, and follow-up activities.
* Drive ongoing inspection readiness across global sites, including preparedness for FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory inspections.
* Partner with site and functional leaders to identify compliance gaps, implement remediation plans, and sustain inspection readiness programs.

Advance the Global Quality Management System

* Ensure effective implementation and governance of quality programs within the division's Quality Management System.
* Assess and manage impacts of evolving global regulations, standards, and industry expectations.
* Own and coordinate standards and regulation change management activities, including impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Support certificate management activities and external certification requirements.

Lead Compliance Improvement & Risk Reduction Efforts

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, training programs, and process improvements.
* Monitor quality metrics, program effectiveness, and compliance trends to proactively mitigate risk.
* Manage and communicate program dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Support Critical Quality Events & Field Actions

* Provide leadership and support for field action strategies and implementation activities when required.
* Support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), Risk Review Evaluation (RRE), and Software Risk Evaluation (SRE) programs to ensure timely completion and compliance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to effectively manage quality records, communications, and closure activities.

Develop a Culture of Quality

* Mentor and advise colleagues across the organization on compliant decision-making and quality best practices.
* Enhance organizational compliance capabilities through training, consultation, and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging compliance risks to help shape future quality strategies and organizational readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
* 13+ years of combined experience in Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional programs in a regulated industry.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and compliance processes.
* Previous management experience.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in a matrixed global organization.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-facing leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience supporting FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, MDSAP, ISO standards, or related regulatory environments.
* International experience and/or foreign language proficiency.
* Experience with audit readiness programs, field actions, regulatory change management, and quality system governance.
* Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect compliance requirements to operational and business outcomes

.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at abbott.com, on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/, and on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/AbbottCareers.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Senior Manager,*** ***MAC Capacity Expansion & Digital Factory Integration***

***Job Code: 46616***

***Job Location: Remote***

***Job Schedule: Varies***

**Job Description:**

The Advanced Operations Technology (AOT) organization is seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Manager, Digital Factory, to lead the strategy, architecture, and implementation of digital manufacturing technologies across our solid rocket motor manufacturing enterprise. This role serves as the organizational owner and subject matter authority for the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure and architecture, Auto-ID systems, manufacturing technology visualization, Key Performance Indicator (KPI) frameworks, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) tools, and data-driven optimization of manufacturing processes and automation equipment performance.

The Senior Manager, Digital Factory will work at the intersection of manufacturing operations, information technology, and advanced engineering to build a connected, intelligent, and highly efficient factory ecosystem. This leader will define and execute a multi-year digital factory roadmap that enables real-time visibility, predictive analytics, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing sites.

This role reports to the Director of Advanced Operations Technology and will collaborate closely with the AOT Chief Engineer, automation engineering teams, IT/OT leadership, program managers, and site operations leadership.

**Essential Functions:**

**Strategy & Roadmap:**

 

* Define, own, and execute the enterprise-wide Digital Factory strategy, aligning with organizational goals for manufacturing modernization, capacity expansion, and operational excellence.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering IIoT, OT infrastructure, Auto-ID, AI/ML integration, visualization platforms, and digital twin capabilities.
* Identify emerging digital manufacturing technologies and assess their applicability and ROI for integration into the manufacturing environment.

**Execution:**

 

* Partner with lead systems architect to define and govern OT network architecture standards, and systems integration (ERP, MES, SCADA, Historian) ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable connectivity between shop floor assets and enterprise systems.
* Lead the strategy and implementation of Auto-ID technologies including barcode, RFID, and other identification and tracking systems to enable end-to-end manufacturing traceability.
* Collaborate with quality, manufacturing engineering, and supply chain teams to ensure Auto-ID solutions meet traceability and compliance requirements.
* Establish the strategy to implement manufacturing dashboards, visualization platforms, and digital work instruction systems that provide real-time operational visibility to all levels of the organization.
* Partner with operations and program leadership to ensure KPI data is actionable and drives continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead the identification, evaluation, and implementation of AI and ML tools to optimize manufacturing processes, predict equipment failures, reduce waste, and improve throughput.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

 

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of digital factory engineers and technology specialists, providing direction, performance management, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including automation engineers, manufacturing engineers, process engineers, quality, maintenance, IT, OT, safety, and Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads to ensure seamless integration of digital factory solutions.
* Manage external vendors, system integrators, and technology partners supporting digital factory initiatives.
* Manage projects from concept to completion, including resource allocation, timeline management, and budget adherence.
* Ensure all digital factory solutions comply with applicable regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality standards.
* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.
* Travel:10%.

**Qualifications**:

 

* Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 12 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 10 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior digital manufacturing, OT/IIoT systems, manufacturing technology experience.
* 5 years experience designing, deploying, and sustaining IIoT platforms and OT network architectures in a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology is preferred.
* Experience leading and managing a team of digital, OT, or manufacturing technology engineers.
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and their integration with shop floor equipment and enterprise systems.
* Experience with OT/IT convergence, including integration of shop floor systems (SCADA, PLC, DCS, Historians) with enterprise systems (ERP, MES).
* Experience developing and implementing KPI frameworks and manufacturing performance dashboards.
* Experience with data acquisition, edge computing, and industrial networking protocols (e.g., OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus, EtherNet/IP).
* Experience developing statements of work, functional requirements specifications, and technology roadmap documents.
* Experience with Auto-ID technologies including RFID, barcode systems, and manufacturing traceability platforms.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for OT environments (NIST SP 800-82, IEC 62443, CMMC).
* Experience with data visualization and BI platforms (e.g., IGNITION, Power BI).
* Experience with cloud and hybrid cloud platforms for industrial data.
* Experience in project management.
* Experience working in a defense, aerospace, or highly regulated manufacturing environment.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $139,500 - $259,500. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $121,500 - $225,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. **Entity:** CSL Plasma

**Job Category:** Quality

**Job Family:** Plasma Center

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** Remote, Puerto Rico, United States

**Employer Reference:** R-294561

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**
============

Lead the development and deployment of quality processes and communications with the assigned region; drive quality culture, competent decision-making, appropriate risk assessments, and timely remediation of situations. Maintain frequent and open communications with executive and corporate leaders that focus on timely resolution of issues that may potentially affect the safety, quality, identity, purity, and/or potency of collected plasma. Review and monitor Quality metrics and reports for trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

**Reports To**: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
 
**Direct Reports:** Assistant Manager of Quality (Approximately 6-7)

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

 
 

* Manage staff, including selecting, training, developing, coaching and terminating, as applicable with guidance from Human Resources. Appraise employee performance and provide feedback and counseling to staff, as applicable.
* Manage compliance to and successful use of the Quality System tools such as change and deviations management.
 
 Ensure regular management review of quality performance that delivers stable, high levels of compliance performance in assigned QA areas. Provide leadership and coordination to established automated systems for control.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) performance to ensure meeting regulatory and departmental requirements, and to drive continual improvement in department processes. Works with CSL applicable systems to analyze and identify significant quality issues/trends and reports those to appropriate Sr. Management. Provides routine reports on the quality KPIs as requested by the applicable business units.
* Maintain understanding of all policies and procedures. Participate in and may lead the development of functional policies and SOPs for assigned areas
* Establish, implement and ensure timely delivery of strategic Quality Assurance performance. Provide direction and guidance on quality topics including resolutions and corrective actions. Perform LSW above center visits. Ensure deployment and sustainability of in-center LSW practices to assigned region.
* Develop & maintain process to disseminate quality interpretation & strategies to operationalize relevant regulations, guidance & standards in collaboration with stakeholders. Maintain & update Quality training materials and provide consistent technical guidance to the operations team. Develop, deploy and occasionally deliver Quality information/publications to appropriate Corporate or Center staff.
* Mentor others on data analysis, technical problem prevention and resolution, design control procedures, investigation processes, and methods to arrive at true root causes as it relates to quality systems.
* Maintain high level of regulatory, compliance and communications skills with department staff, ensuring competence to make decisions and judgments in the course of business, including times of uncertainty.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, to support business needs.
 

 

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Business Administration or Quality Management required; or
* Minimum 8 years equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Fluency in English/Spanish

**Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience successfully serving in a leadership role within an FDA-regulated or other regulated industry required
* Minimum 2 years managing people preferred
* Experience in leading projects to a successful conclusion
* Understand regulatory standards, various local, state, and federal laws that apply to the business and where to find information on standards and interpretations
* Computer literate with knowledge of word processing and spreadsheets
* Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues, and resolve recurring defects
* Strong leadership, training, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal and presentation skills to drive results
* Organizational skills and ability to manage projects involving multiple tasks by a team with deadlines.
* Good leadership and people management skills are essential in the success of leading project teams.
* Establish solid working relationships with to interface with and support senior management, third parties and other positions and circumstances within the organization
* Excellent customer service orientation with flexibility and adaptability to work as a member of the team and respond quickly to changes as required by the business operations
* Maintain a professional demeanor and handle confidential information with discretion
Lead teams without the benefit of a direct reporting relationship 

**Additional Comments**

The person selected for this position **will need to live/relocate to Puerto Rico**; they will be responsible for above-center quality leadership of all centers on the island.

**Working Conditions (physical & mental requirements)**

* Ability to make decisions which have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services
* Ability to formulate complex and comprehensive materials such as authoritative reports of major scope and impact, etc. and/or to make formal presentations
* Exercise good judgment to refer decisions to management when decisions fall out of the realm of established guidelines
* Overnight travel required up to 50% of the time
* Frequent standing and walking
* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 lbs.
Fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions 

Note: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, national origin or other legally protected classifications

existing_roles.description:
**Job Title:**

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering (Burnet, TX)

**Job Description:**

**THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing quality across two Entegris manufacturing sites in Texas and translating global quality standards and quality priorities into consistent site execution. This role provides multi-site leadership to reduce risk, strengthen process capability, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver measurable quality improvements across the two-site footprint. 
 
The Senior Manager partners with site Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Quality, Product Quality and Quality Systems teams to embed quality ownership into daily operations. This leader is accountable for site quality performance, consistent implementation of quality standards, compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements, and the development of capable site quality teams. The role leads through site quality leaders and teams, establishes clear ownership and follow-through, and escalates risks and resource needs to North America quality leadership.

The hired individual will work on-site at our Burnet, TX location with some travel to our Decatur, TX location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Translate global quality standards and quality priorities into coordinated execution plans for the two Texas sites, with clear owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead manufacturing quality across all two sites through site quality leaders and teams; clarify responsibilities, prioritize resources based on risk, and maintain regular on-site engagement.
* Ensure consistent implementation of global quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices; maintain audit readiness and timely closure of findings at each site.
* Partner with site Operations leaders to establish quality roadmaps, objectives, and common key performance indicators (KPIs); conduct routine cross-site reviews and drive recovery plans where performance falls short.
* Own quality improvement plans that reduce defects, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality (COPQ), customer complaints, and manufacturing escapes, with site-level accountability for results.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability, product conformity, yield, and manufacturing performance through effective process controls and proactive risk management.
* Lead targeted continuous improvement and change implementation across the two sites; standardize effective practices and verify that improvements are sustained.
* Ensure timely containment, disciplined root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and effectiveness verification for significant quality issues; deploy lessons learned across all two sites.
* Ensure practical, sustained application of SPC, MSA, FMEA, control plans, APQP, PPAP, 8D, A3, and DMAIC methodologies, as applicable to site processes and customer requirements.
* Serve as the quality escalation leader for the two Texas sites; communicate risk, containment status, recovery plans, and decisions needed, and escalate significant issues to Quality leadership.
* Partner with Customer Quality and Product Quality teams to resolve customer issues through timely, evidence-based investigations, effective corrective actions, and proactive communication.
* Develop site quality leaders and teams through coaching, clear expectations, technical capability building, and succession planning; identify staffing and resource needs across the two sites.
* Foster shared quality ownership across functions, reinforce accountability for commitments, and promote collaboration and continuous improvement across the two sites.
* Travel requirements will be a minimum of 25%, including regular presence across the two Texas sites.

**WHAT WE SEEK**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including leadership responsibility for quality teams and manufacturing quality outcomes.
* 5+ years of quality management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead through site leaders or cross-functional teams; multi-site leadership experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing quality systems and delivering sustained improvements in manufacturing quality, process capability, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coordinate priorities, standardize practices, and maintain effective leadership presence across two manufacturing sites in Texas.
* Experience supporting customer and supplier quality requirements, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable regulatory and industry requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence site leaders, resolve competing priorities, and communicate risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience coaching quality leaders, developing technical capability, and building team depth and succession readiness across sites.
* Demonstrated ability to lead practical change, establish clear ownership, and sustain common quality practices in partnership with Operations and Engineering.
* Strong problem-solving, data analysis, and business acumen, with practical application of quality tools to prioritize risk, improve manufacturing processes, and deliver measurable results.

**WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS?** 
Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. 
 
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

**WHAT WE OFFER** 
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

* Compensation: The salary range for this position is $134,000- $196,500 per year. Final compensation will depend on the candidate's overall skills and qualifications for the role.
* Annual bonus eligibility
* Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
* Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
* Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
* Education assistance to support your learning journey
* A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence

*Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.*

*At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.*

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing (Robot Production)
existing_roles.description:
**About Genesis**
=================

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration, and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We are French and American by birth and global by nature. We are backed by partners who share our vision, including Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, and HSG, alongside Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, Daniela Rus, and Vladlen Koltun. Our people work across the Bay Area and Europe, building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model, and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

**The role**
------------

We build general-purpose robots, and next year we start building them in volume. You will be the manufacturing leader who takes the robot from engineering builds to production. Our CA facility is where new products are introduced: the process is designed, the first stations are built and proven, and the technicians are trained there. Volume production runs with a manufacturing partner, on their floor or on ours with their people, and you own the process in both cases. You design how the robot gets built, you lead the engineers and technicians who prove it, and you own the quality gate that decides when a unit leaves.

This is hands-on work. You design the first station, write the first work instruction, and bring the partner's team up to our standard. What exists today: an engineering build process with our design team, a production partner, a bill of materials and a plan. What does not exist yet is the production process, and that is the job.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design the production process: layout and cycle time, line balancing, station and fixture design, end-of-line test and calibration, material flow.
* Capacity planning: stations, equipment, people and hours by build phase, from the first units to rate, and the plan to add capacity ahead of demand.
* Specify, source and commission fixtures, tooling and test equipment: requirements, RFQ with Supply Chain, acceptance at the vendor and on the floor.
* Own process documentation under revision control: work instructions with photos and video, PFMEA, control plans, inspection plans, SOPs; keep the manufacturing BOM aligned with the engineering BOM and run engineering changes through to the floor.
* Run the transfer from engineering builds to production: pilot builds, DFM and DFA feedback with the authority to push back, build readiness reviews at each phase gate, release to volume.
* Package the process so it can be copied: one documented set of stations, fixtures, test, instructions and training that a partner's floor can run to the same yield as ours.
* Build and lead the team: manufacturing engineers, test engineers and technicians; hiring pace, training and certification, trainer capacity, shift structure as volume grows.
* Own the quality gate: first-pass yield, defect capture, root cause (8D, SPC, DOE where it earns its keep), closed-loop feedback to engineering and suppliers; nothing ships that quality has not passed.
* Partner with Supply Chain on clear-to-build so no unit starts without a complete kit, and with the manufacturing partner so their team runs our process to our standard.
* Stand up the systems as we grow: traceability by serial, MES-lite at first, then the real thing; the weekly numbers (yield, hours per unit, cost per unit, downtime, schedule adherence) and the readout to leadership.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You have taken a complex electromechanical product from prototype through pilot to volume and designed the process yourself, not inherited it. Robots, vehicles, drones, medical devices, industrial equipment all count.
* You have transferred a process to a contract manufacturer and held them to your standard.
* Strong manufacturing engineering foundation: time studies, line balancing, capacity planning, fixture and tooling design, test strategy, PFMEA and control plans, lean and continuous improvement; CAD and GD&T fluency.
* You have hired and trained technicians, written certification criteria, and know that trained people are the real constraint on throughput.
* You have run a quality gate and held it under schedule pressure.
* You are on the floor every day and rigorous in the data.
* 8 or more years in manufacturing engineering or production, with time in a mature organization so you know what good looks like at scale, and 3 or more years leading people.
* Bonus: actuators, gearboxes or precision assemblies; PLM, MES and ERP implementation; product safety certification processes.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

Production and lab environments; travel to partner sites, up to 25%.

**Why this role**
-----------------

You build the way our robots get built, from the first station to rate, and the process and the team that do it are yours.

**How we work**
---------------

We are always looking for people who are driven to work on hard problems and want to shape what the world will look like in ten years. A few of the values that guide us:

* **Limitless ambition.** We hold ourselves to the highest bar in everything we build.
* **Relentless urgency.** Iterate faster, learn faster. Time is the denominator.
* **Type-2 Fun.** Take the work seriously, not yourself. Embrace the grind and find joy in the struggle.
* **Radical transparency.** Candid communication builds trust, and direct feedback drives growth.
* **Multiculturalism.** We come from across the world. Be curious. Meet people on their terms.
* **Team over ego.** Help others, share context, and win as a team.
* **A joyful journey.** We take pride in the craft.

existing_roles.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As Senior Vice President, Quality Engineering Manager for Payments Technology, you will own the test strategy for CitiDirect, Citi's award winning digital banking platform that gives clients one-click access to global transaction capabilities across payments, liquidity and trade. You will direct multiple testing teams, set the standards for test automation and User Acceptance Testing, and make sure every release of CitiDirect and its connected systems meets a high quality bar before reaching production. This is an opportunity to shape how a global bank validates mission critical payments technology and to build a modern, automated testing organization.

 
 

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the test strategy for CitiDirect and its upstream and downstream applications across the Payments, Liquidity and Trade domains.

* Direct multiple testing teams, setting priorities and resolving complex issues that carry significant business impact.

* Design and implement User Acceptance Testing scripts and plans together with technology project managers, UAT professionals and business users.

* Build testing standards and quality benchmarks that keep automation, documentation and release processes consistent across teams.

* Plan and coordinate cross-team testing dependencies to keep releases on schedule and reduce production risk.

* Partner with development teams, IT project managers, business stakeholders and external vendors to align testing approach with delivery goals.

* Manage team performance and development, including hiring, coaching, compensation decisions and career planning for testing professionals.

* Assess risk in every release decision and escalate control issues early to protect Citi and its clients.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in a testing environment, including senior level people management experience.

* Deep understanding of Systems Development Life Cycle processes and end to end testing methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Quality Center and related testing platforms.

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate and influence at a senior level.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex and unfamiliar testing situations.

* A track record of leading teams to deliver high quality results under tight deadlines.

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured or SoapUI.

* Programming skills in Java, Python or JavaScript, combined with background in payments technology, cloud platforms and Agile or Scrum delivery, and a track record of moving manual QA functions to automated testing.:

* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.

* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.

* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

**What We Offer**

Based at Citi's Jersey City location, you will lead a testing function that supports a payments platform used by clients around the world, with the backing and resources of a global technology organization.

* Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.

* Shape testing strategy and standards for a platform operating across global markets, with real influence on outcomes.

* Access ongoing learning and leadership development programs to continue growing your career in technology.

* Collaborate with testing, development and business teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

* Benefit from financial wellbeing programs, healthcare coverage and family support resources.

Apply now to lead the quality engineering strategy behind one of Citi's most critical payments platforms.

existing_roles.description:
## Overview

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Plant Manager to lead our operations at our facility in Canton, OH, 44720. As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, and quality standards are met. If you have a passion for manufacturing and a knack for team leadership, we want to hear from you!

## Responsibilities

* Oversee daily plant operations and manage production schedules to meet customer demands.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety among all employees.

existing_roles.title: Vice President, Quality & Food Safety
existing_roles.description:
Description:

**Who We Are**

Headquartered in Vineland, NJ, F&S Fresh Foods is leading the way in fresh-cut fruit, vegetables, and meal solutions distribution. With the recent acquisition of five additional state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across the U.S., we now deliver to customers across the United States and Canada — every single day!

For over 40 years, we’ve been redefining production and safety processes, building strong partnerships, and creating endless possibilities for our diverse customers — from restaurants and supermarket prepared food operations to convenience store chains and beyond. At F&S, we are fueling families with nutrition, innovation, and convenience, turning meals into memorable moments. By combining cutting-edge technology, deep-rooted customer relationships, and operational excellence, we are shaping the future of fresh — from farm to family.

We’re not just about food; we’re about people. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, our team of 2,100 full-time employees drives our culture forward by living our values every day. If you’re ready to be part of a company that values innovation, excellence, and community impact, join us as we embrace our next exciting chapter of growth. Together, we’re planting the seeds of progress and nourishing a fresh, healthy future for everyone!

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401(K) including company match!
* Paid Time Off annually + Paid Holidays
* Career Advancement opportunities and Tuition Assistance

**What’s the Role**

The Vice President, Quality & Food Safety is F&S Fresh Foods’ senior executive leader for Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality across all of our facilities. This role sets the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and systems that keep our products safe, consistent, and compliant with every regulatory, customer, and certification requirement. As the company’s senior authority on food safety risk, audit readiness, and crisis management, you will protect consumers, customers, and the F&S brand while partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Development, Sales, and Executive Leadership. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader who earns the trust of customers and regulators, develops strong teams, and champions a culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* Set and execute the long-term Quality and Food Safety strategy, including enterprise goals, standards, KPIs, and governance processes aligned with business objectives
* Lead all corporate Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality functions, ensuring consistent programs across all facilities
* Own the enterprise Food Safety Management System, including HACCP, Preventive Controls, Environmental Monitoring, Allergen Management, Traceability, Food Defense, and pathogen control
* Establish and maintain enterprise quality management systems so products consistently meet specifications, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements
* Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, state, local, and customer requirements, interpreting emerging regulations and maintaining audit and inspection readiness at every site
* Serve as senior liaison with regulatory agencies, certification bodies, and customer auditors, overseeing closure of audit findings, regulatory actions, and corrective actions
* Serve as executive authority and decision-maker for food safety incidents, recalls, and crisis response, maintaining risk assessment, traceability, mock recall, and incident management programs
* Represent F&S during customer visits, audits, business reviews, and quality events, building strategic relationships and leading resolution of significant complaints and brand-risk events
* Partner with Commercial, Product Development, and Operations to support growth while maintaining product integrity and improving customer satisfaction
* Establish supplier approval, audit, and monitoring standards and drive supplier performance improvement, partnering with Procurement to mitigate supply chain risk
* Drive data-based improvement to reduce defects, waste, and customer complaints and improve process capability, publishing executive dashboards and performance updates for leadership
* Lead and develop Directors, Managers, and technical leaders, building succession plans, bench strength, and a culture of accountability, engagement, and high performance
* Establish enterprise training standards and competency requirements, partnering with Operations and Human Resources to build food safety and quality into talent development and performance management
* Champion a companywide culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility, promoting proactive risk identification and continuous improvement
* Serve as the company’s senior subject matter expert on food safety, quality systems, microbiology, compliance, and regulatory matters
* Participate in strategic planning, acquisition integration activities, and enterprise transformation initiatives

Requirements:

**What You Bring**

* Must have: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Technology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred
* Must have: HACCP and Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) certifications
* Must have: 15+ years of progressive Quality and Food Safety leadership, including 7+ years leading multi-site organizations
* Must have: Extensive experience in fresh, refrigerated, ready-to-eat, produce, protein, or other highly regulated food manufacturing
* Must have: Proven success leading customer audits, regulatory inspections, certification audits, recalls, and crisis events
* Must have: Strong knowledge of FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, Environmental Monitoring Programs, and Quality Systems
* Nice to have: Lead Auditor, SQF Practitioner, BRCGS, or equivalent certification
* Personal quality: Strategic, consumer- and customer-focused decision-maker who uses metrics, risk assessments, and audit results to set priorities while balancing operational and commercial objectives
* Personal quality: Executive presence and influence with customers, regulators, and leadership, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering measurable results

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.
