existing_roles.title: Plant Manager
existing_roles.description:
**Company Description**

With over $2B in revenue, 80+ manufacturing facilities across 6 continents and over 9,000 employees worldwide, Signode is a leading manufacturer of a broad spectrum of transit packaging consumables, tools, software, and equipment that optimize end-of-line packaging operations and protect products in transit. Signode brings this extensive product portfolio together under hundreds of trusted brands to offer complete transit packaging solutions to its customers. 
 
We produce strap, stretch and protective packaging. We also manufacture packaging tools and equipment used to apply the bulk packaging materials. These commercial packaging products are used to pack, bundle, unitize, protect, and secure goods during warehousing and transit. Our company is a pioneer in the industrial packaging sector with a long history of customer-focused innovations in materials, processes and automation technology that have revolutionized the sector. 
 
Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we are proud to be the Transit Packaging Division of Crown Holdings, Inc. We are excited to go to market as Signode and to share the portfolio of products, services and capabilities that make us the world’s premier end-of-line packaging company.

 **Job Description**

**Benefits:**

Signode offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees, which includes health, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off, life insurance, wellness perks, and more. Benefits begin the month following the hire date.

**Summary**

This role is for a Plant Manager who is a true leader, one who can build a strong, positive culture throughout the plant. The position calls for a sharp operational and analytical mind that constantly seeks out, teaches, and leads improvements in Safety Performance, Cost Control, Standardized Processes (LEAN), Production Reporting, and Inventory Control.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead one of Signode’s most important locations, having a big impact on our ability to deliver a profitable year. Here is what makes this role stand out:

* Pilot the company’s Operational Excellence system, delivering a glidepath in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Output, and Morale.
* Take charge of a major turnaround facility. The right leader is confident yet humble, ready to run a 24/7 site from the bottom up, and understands the sweat and equity required to turn it around.
* Succeed here, and fast-track your path to the next level.

**Essential Functions**

* Directly manage and coordinate the activities of various plant departments and sites within Signode.
* Provide strong leadership to the manufacturing team, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve production goals, optimize processes, and enhance overall plant efficiency.
* Communicate, uphold and enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance to maintain a safe and secure working environment.
* Responsible for talent management and employee lifecycle activities, from hiring to terminating.
* Collaborate with senior management to align plant operations with organizational objectives.
* Monitor and analyze production metrics, ensuring that production targets are met while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Implement efficiency improvement initiatives and address any bottlenecks or issues in the production process.
* Efficiently allocate resources, including manpower and equipment, to meet production schedules and deadlines.
* Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure optimal functionality of machinery and equipment.
* Collaborate with the quality control department to ensure that products meet or exceed quality standards.
* Implement measures to address any deviations or non-conformities in the production process.
* Develop and manage budgets for the manufacturing facility(s), controlling costs and optimizing resource utilization.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement measures to improve overall plant profitability.
* Effectively communicate with senior management, department heads, and front-line staff to ensure clear understanding of goals and objectives.
* Prepare regular reports on plant performance, production metrics, and other relevant KPIs.
* Lead and support initiatives for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance plant processes, reduce waste, and increase overall efficiency.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Management, Business, or Engineering. Masters Degree in similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum of 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, with at least 5 -7 years in a managerial or supervisory role. **Previous experience as a plant manager is a must.**

* Financial Acumen with the ability to analyze and forecast data and translate results to better solutions. With the understanding of general ledger accounting and activity rate costing.
* Strong knowledge of safety metrics and programs.
* TPM mastery
* **Previous experience leading a turnaround factory**
* Extrusion technical skills
* ERP system knowledge a plus.
* LEAN Manufacturing Training or CI Management Experience (Tier I, II, III)

**Functional Success Drivers:** These competencies are what we require for an individual to be successful in this role.

* Strategic Skills
* Leadership
* Result Oriented
* Safety & Security
* Communication (Oral & Written)
* Analytical Skills
* Inspiring “Followership”
* Vision

 
**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The Company does not sponsor for employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities.

Signode is committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, including providing reasonable accommodations during our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodation in applying for this position, please contact us at HRRecruiting@Signode.com.

*The Company has reviewed this job description to ensure that essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. This document does not represent a contract of employment, and the Company reserves the right to change this job description and/or assign tasks for the employee to perform, as the Company may deem appropriate.*

Signode participates in E-Verify and will provide the Department of Homeland Security your Form I-9 information to confirm your authorization to work in the United States.

Signode Industrial Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

existing_roles.title: Plant Manager- tissue and paper manufacturing
existing_roles.description:
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing executive with deep **paper manufacturing and paper machine operations experience**. Our client is seeking a hands-on, results-driven leader who can take full ownership of plant performance, strengthen operational discipline, and lead the facility to improved results across **safety, quality, production, reliability, cost and people development**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for all aspects of plant operations and will play a key role in driving performance improvements, stabilizing underperforming areas, and building a strong culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This role is ideal for a seasoned Plant Manager or senior operations leader who understands the complexity of paper manufacturing and has a track record of improving plant performance through strong leadership, technical knowledge, disciplined execution and data-driven decision-making.

The Plant Manager will oversee the day-to-day and strategic leadership of the facility, ensuring the plant operates safely, efficiently and profitably while developing both leadership and frontline teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve established **safety, quality, production, reliability and financial objectives**.
* Build and reinforce a strong **safety culture** through visible leadership, clear expectations, coaching and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Oversee plant performance and ensure operations are aligned with productivity, quality and cost targets.
* Optimize **paper machine performance**, equipment uptime, production output and finished-product quality.
* Improve equipment reliability through strong maintenance systems, including preventive and predictive maintenance, planning and scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Manage and improve plant financial performance, including cost-per-ton, labour, maintenance, fibre, chemical and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts using structured, data-driven problem-solving methodologies to improve operational and financial results.
* Develop and execute recovery or turnaround plans for underperforming operations, establishing clear priorities, ownership, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Build, coach and strengthen plant leadership, technical and hourly teams through employee development, performance management, succession planning and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, production, quality and leadership teams to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution of plant priorities.
* Establish a culture focused on **performance, engagement, ownership and continuous improvement**.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a strong plant leader with deep technical and operational knowledge of **paper manufacturing**, particularly **paper machine operations**, who can lead a large team and drive measurable business results.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing** or a related field is preferred.
* 10–15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* **Must have direct paper manufacturing experience**, including demonstrated technical knowledge of **paper machine operations**.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and delivering sustainable improvements in performance, reliability and quality.
* Demonstrated success improving underperforming facilities or leading plant turnaround/recovery initiatives.
* Strong understanding of **papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, plant operations and financial management**.
* Experience managing key manufacturing metrics, including productivity, equipment uptime, cost control and quality performance.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, drive accountability and guide organizational change effectively.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence performance at all levels of the plant.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Enter your email
* Available time for call

Experience:

* tissue and paper manufacturing operation: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: On the road

existing_roles.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
existing_roles.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations. 
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives. 
 
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A) 
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness 

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

 
2. M&A Operations Integration 

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

 
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization 

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

 
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability 

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership 

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen 

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise 

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution 

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration 

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
* Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management
* Supplier Transfers or Manufacturing Transfers
* Mergers, Acquisitions, and Business Integration
* Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations Program Management
* Proven people-management experience, including leading managers and technical professionals in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong knowledge of supplier qualification, supplier development, capacity planning, quality agreements, process validation, and manufacturing transfer principles.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and manage supply-base risk, including sole-source exposure, capacity constraints, supplier quality issues, and business-continuity risks.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, cost analysis, budget ownership, and value-capture management.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting medical-device product launches and design-transfer activities.
* Experience integrating acquired companies, product portfolios, manufacturing sites, or supplier networks.
* Familiarity with regulated quality systems and supplier-control expectations.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or structured problem-solving methodologies.

* Professional certifications in program management, supply chain, quality, or lean methodologies are desirable.

existing_roles.title: Director, Commercial Operations and Asset Management
existing_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Director, Commercial Operations & Asset Management provides leadership over the operational execution and ongoing asset management of Rhyze’s Commercial lending platform. This role is accountable for establishing scalable, controlled processes across transaction closing, funding, participation, servicing and portfolio administration, while actively overseeing the performance, credit quality and risk profile of the commercial real estate loan portfolio.

The Director leads portfolio surveillance, borrower and property performance monitoring, covenant compliance, annual review coordination, delinquency management and the operational execution of workout and loss mitigation strategies. The position works closely with the Managing Director, Commercial; Capital Markets; and Legal, and coordinates with lead lenders, borrowers, servicing partners and participating credit unions as appropriate.

The successful candidate combines commercial real estate credit and asset management expertise with operational discipline, sound judgment, strong communication skills and a focus on scalable execution.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Commercial Portfolio & Asset Management**

· Lead portfolio surveillance and risk-based monitoring of commercial real estate loans, including payment performance, DSCR, net operating income, occupancy, rent rolls, leasing, borrower liquidity, maturities and concentration exposure.

· Oversee borrower and property financial reporting, covenant testing and compliance calendars; identify reporting deficiencies, covenant breaches, emerging risks and required follow-up.

· Coordinate annual and interim credit reviews, risk-rating assessments, watchlist management and action plans, with documented findings, ownership, deadlines and management escalation.

· Oversee collateral protection requirements, including insurance, property taxes, escrows, reserves, liens, property inspections, appraisals and other third-party assessments, in coordination with Servicing and Legal.

**Special Assets & Loss Mitigation**

· Identify and escalate delinquencies, maturity or covenant defaults and deteriorating credits; coordinate borrower outreach, collection strategies and remediation plans for criticized or classified assets.

· Evaluate requests for waivers, modifications, extensions, forbearances and other accommodations; develop supporting analysis and recommendations for authorized decision-makers.

· Coordinate workout and loss mitigation activities with Commercial leadership, Legal and external counsel, including enforcement, bankruptcy or foreclosure matters when applicable.

· Prepare required participant notices and approval packages; document borrower communications, decisions, conditions and deadlines, and monitor execution and performance under approved resolution plans.

**Commercial Operations & Servicing Oversight**

· Lead day-to-day Commercial operations with clear accountability, service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures across the loan lifecycle.

· Oversee transaction closing, funding, loan boarding and post-closing administration, including conditions, documentation, milestone tracking, data transfers and outstanding exceptions.

· Coordinate with internal teams, servicing partners and Capital Markets on participation administration, payment processing, reconciliations, escrows, reserves, borrower notices, payoffs, releases and related servicing matters.

· Ensure accurate implementation and recording of approved modifications, extensions and other post-closing actions, consistent with loan documents, participation agreements, delegated authority and applicable requirements.

**Operational Excellence, Reporting & Scalability**

· Provide timely loan-level and portfolio reporting to management and participating investors, including delinquencies, covenant exceptions, watchlist activity, material credit events and remediation progress.

· Serve as a central coordinator across Commercial, Capital Markets, Finance, Legal, servicing partners, lead lenders and participating credit unions on operational and portfolio matters.

· Develop and standardize procedures, controls, checklists, templates and reporting; identify opportunities for automation, integration and improved data quality to support scalable growth.

· Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including reporting compliance, review completion, exception aging, delinquency trends, watchlist resolution and transaction cycle times.

**Other**· Responsible for effective self/workload management. Demonstrates clear written and verbal communication skills. Promotes collaboration and a positive, professional work environment. Attends all position related meetings to ensure proper communication/planning occurs.

· Performs other related duties as assigned by the Managing Director

· Complies with all company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Care for non-public information (NPI) and ensuring that confidentiality of company, borrowers, and partner information is maintained.

· Responsible for contributing to a positive work environment and culture that represents the company values.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.

· Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in commercial real estate lending, commercial credit administration, loan servicing, asset management, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing commercial loan portfolios.

· Strong understanding of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan documentation, closing, funding, servicing, portfolio administration, and loan participations.

· Demonstrated expertise in commercial real estate asset management, including financial statement analysis, property performance monitoring, debt service coverage, covenant compliance, collateral valuation, and credit risk assessment.

· Experience identifying and managing problem loans, including delinquencies, covenant defaults, borrower accommodations, forbearances, modifications, workouts, and loss mitigation strategies.

· Strong knowledge of commercial loan servicing practices, including payment administration, escrow and reserve management, collateral protection, and post-closing compliance.

· Demonstrated ability to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging credit risks, develop actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate findings to management and other stakeholders.

· Experience establishing and improving operational processes, internal controls, reporting practices, and technology-enabled workflows to support efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

· Strong understanding of commercial lending regulatory requirements, credit policies, risk management practices, and financial institution governance.

· Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional activities, and lead complex initiatives with a high degree of accountability and attention to detail.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage borrowers, lending partners, credit union executives, and internal stakeholders.

· Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented environment.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $185,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

existing_roles.description:
Job ID

JR112695

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Job Summary**

The Senior Director, Semiconductor Sourcing and NPI Procurement leads the global strategy, sourcing, and supplier ecosystem for wafer foundry services, IP and EDA services, discrete actives semiconductors, and 3rd party NAND flash controller categories as well as the New Product Introduction Procurement function. This role is accountable for delivering cost competitiveness, supply assurance, and long-term resilience across a complex semiconductor value chain.

Partnering closely with engineering, manufacturing, and business leaders, the role drives category strategies, supplier performance, and risk mitigation at category and product level while enabling Micron’s growth and innovation priorities. Success in this role requires deep semiconductor domain expertise, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to lead large, global teams to deliver enterprise-level outcomes.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Define and execute global procurement strategies for wafer foundry services, IP and EDA services, discrete actives semiconductors, and 3rd party NAND flash controller categories to support business growth and operational excellence
* Drive adherence to New Product Introduction metrics such as multi-sourcing, part reuse and golden part usage through stage gate reviews and collaboration with commodity category sourcing teams.
* Lead category management, ensuring cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and alignment with Micron’s strategic and financial objectives
* Build and manage strategic supplier partnerships, driving collaboration, performance accountability, and continuous improvement across the supplier ecosystem
* Ensure supply assurance through proactive capacity planning, demand-supply alignment, and risk mitigation strategies, including development of resilient global sourcing networks
* Drive end-to-end sourcing execution, including commercial negotiations, contract management, and supplier performance governance
* Lead cost optimization initiatives and negotiations to achieve best-in-class total cost of ownership
* Partner with cross-functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, supply chain) to support product, technology, and operational requirements
* Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing global procurement organization, including leading leaders and building long-term capability
* Establish KPIs and performance frameworks to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement across procurement and supplier performance
* Provide strategic leadership aligned to corporate priorities, ensuring clear line of sight from category execution to enterprise outcomes

**Other Responsibilities**

* Drive supplier diversity, sustainability, and responsible sourcing initiatives aligned with Micron’s commitments
* Strengthen procurement analytics, predictive capabilities, and digital transformation initiatives
* Represent procurement in executive-level forums and contribute to enterprise strategic planning
* Support crisis management and rapid response for supply disruptions or geopolitical risks
* Mentor emerging leaders and build succession pipelines within the procurement organization

* Integrate AI-enabled tools and predictive insights into procurement, sourcing, and supplier management to improve decision quality and efficiency
* Identify and scale AI-driven opportunities (e.g., demand forecasting, risk analytics, cost modeling) within procurement operations
* Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement through responsible AI adoption

**Candidate Profile / Job Requirements**

**Minimum Required Qualifications / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent practical experience
* 15+ years of experience across semiconductor manufacturing, procurement, or supplier management
* Proven experience operating at a global or enterprise leadership level, driving cross-functional business outcomes
* Track record in managing complex supplier ecosystems and outsourced manufacturing models

**Must Have Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of wafer foundry landscape and ASIC development and manufacturing models (technical, operational, and commercial dimensions).
* Strong commercial acumen with experience negotiating complex, high-value agreements
* Expertise in category strategy, cost modeling, and total cost of ownership optimization
* Strong knowledge of global supply chain risks, capacity planning, and supplier performance management
* Familiarity with procurement analytics, digital tools, and data-driven decision-making

**Must Have Soft Skills**

* Strong enterprise leadership capability, including leading leaders and influencing across global organizations
* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into execution
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across executive and operational levels
* High resilience and decision-making capability in complex, ambiguous environments
* Ability to build and lead high-performing, scalable teams

**AI Requirements**

* Demonstrates strong digital fluency and ability to leverage AI-enabled tools in procurement, analytics, and decision-making
* Applies AI responsibly in alignment with organizational standards and governance

**Highly Desirable / Preferred**

* Experience sourcing discrete active semiconductor components used in SSD and Memory Modules
* Experience managing IP and EDA suppliers
* Exposure to global manufacturing networks
* Experience leading procurement transformation or digital initiatives
* Strong understanding of semiconductor market dynamics and macro trends

**Embody Micron’s Core Values**

* People – Respect, develop, and empower others
* Innovation – Drive continuous improvement and breakthrough thinking
* Tenacity – Demonstrate grit and resilience
* Collaboration – Build trust across global teams and partners
* Customer Focus – Deliver value and enable business success

The US base salary range that Micron Technology estimates it could pay for this full-time position is:

$199,000.00 - $349,000.00 a year

Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses and equity.

*Join the worldwide leader in playing cards and in “play” solutions. Play is what keeps us going, and it always has been our greatest motivation. That's why we* ***live different****,* ***play different****.*

We are seeking an experienced **NPI Director North America - Solutions** to provide regional leadership for New Product Introduction across North America, covering the relevant manufacturing sites and Design Center capabilities. The role translates business and customer priorities into a coherent NPI strategy, governance model and project portfolio, ensuring that new products move from concept to stable commercialization with the required quality, cost, timing, compliance and manufacturability. The role aligns Commercial, Global Design Center, NPI, Engineering, R&D, Quality, Procurement and Manufacturing and develops the capabilities required for consistent execution across sites..

**Key Responsibilities:**

**NPI strategy and governance**

* Translate the global NPI strategy into the North American operating model, stage-gate governance, priorities and decision routines, aligned with the Global Accounts and Global Design Center Director.
* Own the North American NPI portfolio and facilitate prioritization, resource allocation, escalation and trade-off decisions across customer programs and manufacturing sites in the region.
* Implement and continuously improve common global standards, templates, performance measures and management routines for product development, prototyping, design transfer, validation and industrialization.
* Ensure early NPI and Design Center involvement in strategic customer opportunities and new product concepts.

**Portfolio delivery and industrialization**

* Oversee major and complex NPI programs from concept through commercialization and stable production handover.

existing_roles.description:
Ferrotherm is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Vice President of Operations** to lead and optimize all aspects of manufacturing operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, developing organizational capabilities, and supporting the company's continued growth while strengthening strategic customer relationships within the aerospace industry.

The Vice President of Operations will oversee all operational functions, ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality, airworthy products to aerospace OEM, defense, and turbine engine customers. As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, this individual will translate strategy into operational execution while delivering results in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability.

The successful candidate will be a strategic leader with a proven track record of building high-performing teams, driving operational excellence, and leading growth initiatives within aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.

**People Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop operational leaders across the organization within a union manufacturing environment.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Develop succession plans and leadership pipelines for critical operational positions.
* Reinforce Ferrotherm's commitment to safety, quality, integrity, customer focus, and business excellence.
* Create an environment where employees are empowered to identify risks, solve problems, and drive meaningful improvements.

**Executive Operations Leadership**

* Develop and execute operational strategies that support revenue growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and long-term business objectives.
* Establish operational goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), and accountability systems aligned with company objectives.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Information Technology, and Human Resources to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the President and Executive Leadership Team on operational risk, capacity planning, and capital investment priorities.
* Act as the executive operational liaison for key customers, supporting executive reviews, audits, escalation meetings, and strategic business discussions.

**Manufacturing Operations & Production Execution**

* Provide executive leadership for machining, assembly, heat treatment, special processes, preventative maintenance, and production support functions.
* Drive continuous improvement in safety, quality, throughput, productivity, utilization, and on-time delivery performance.
* Ensure production plans are executed efficiently while maintaining compliance with customer, regulatory, and internal requirements.
* Implement visual management systems, performance metrics, and accountability processes that support operational excellence.
* Lead initiatives to reduce lead times, improve manufacturing flow, eliminate bottlenecks, and expand capacity.
* Ensure operational readiness for production increases, new product introductions (NPI), and strategic program launches.

**Supply Chain & Planning Leadership**

* Oversee purchasing, supplier management, inventory control, logistics, production planning, and scheduling.
* Drive supplier performance improvements focused on quality, delivery, responsiveness, and cost.
* Develop and maintain robust Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) processes to align customer demand with inventory strategy, available capacity, and production resources.
* Lead risk mitigation efforts related to material availability and supplier constraints.
* Ensure inventory strategies support customer delivery requirements while optimizing working capital.

**Quality, Compliance & Aerospace Standards**

* Provide executive leadership and support for the effectiveness of Ferrotherm's Quality Management System in partnership with the Director of Quality.
* Promote a culture where quality is built into processes, not inspected into products.
* Support successful customer, certification, and regulatory audits.
* Ensure operational processes maintain full product traceability, configuration control, and compliance with airworthiness requirements.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Develop and manage annual operational budgets and capital expenditure plans.
* Drive EBITDA improvement through productivity gains, cost reduction initiatives, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, inventory, and facility resources.
* Monitor operational financial performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Evaluate and justify investments in equipment, automation, facilities, and technology.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including executive-level responsibility.
* Proven experience in aerospace, aviation, defense, turbine engine, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments involving precision machining.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 Quality Management Systems, aerospace manufacturing standards, root cause corrective action methodologies, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, managing organizational change, and delivering measurable business results.
* Strong strategic planning, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with a Tier 1 or Tier 2 aerospace supplier supporting organizations such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, Rolls-Royce, Safran, Honeywell, Collins Aerospace, Boeing, Airbus, Lockheed Martin, or similar customers.
* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other operational excellence certifications are highly desirable.

**Why Join Ferrotherm?**

At Ferrotherm, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. You will help shape operational strategy, lead high-performing teams, and contribute to delivering world-class products to some of the industry's most respected aerospace and defense customers.

If you are a strategic and results-oriented operations executive with a passion for manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply.

*Ferrotherm is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.*

Benefits:

* 100% Employer paid Health / Dental / Vision Insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off including annual Christmas Holiday shutdown (6 days) and 6 paid holidays.
* Long Term Disability insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related discipline?
* Do you have at least 10 years of leadership experience in aerospace, aviation, defense, turbine engine, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment?
* Have you held responsibility for an entire manufacturing operation, plant, business unit, or multi-site operation as a Vice President, Director, General Manager, Plant Manager, or equivalent senior leadership role?
* Do you have direct experience working within an AS9100-certified manufacturing environment?
* Have you been responsible for managing operating budgets, capital expenditures, and P&L performance?

Position Information

**Be a Tar Heel!**

A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn.

One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community.

University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** for numerous retail, restaurant and performing arts discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates on select campus events. UNC-Chapel Hill offers full-time employees a **comprehensive benefits package**, paid leave, and a variety of health, life and retirement plans and additional programs that support a healthy work/life balance.

 

**Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit**

The UNC Adams School of Dentistry Dean’s Office provides oversight for the Adams School of Dentistry and serves as the liaison to the University, citizens, alumni and friends.

 

**Position Summary**

The Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation provides strategic project leadership and organizational improvement expertise to strengthen the operations and services that support the Adams School of Dentistry’s education of future oral health professionals, advancement of research and discovery, and delivery of exceptional patient care. The position leads complex, high-priority initiatives designed to transform and improve ASOD operations, organizational effectiveness, service delivery, and the experience of faculty, staff, students, patients, and other stakeholders.
 
 
Working collaboratively with ASOD leadership and stakeholders across the School and University, the Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation identifies organizational and operational challenges and opportunities for improvement; defines, scopes, and prioritizes projects; analyzes current-state processes and organizational needs; and facilitates the development of solutions aligned with ASOD priorities. The position serves as a strategic thought partner to leadership and applies project management, change management, analytical, and continuous improvement approaches to complex issues that may cross multiple departments, programs, and functional areas.
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation leads initiatives through the full project lifecycle, including project definition and planning, analysis and solution design, implementation, change management, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities include establishing project goals, deliverables, measures of success, and implementation strategies; coordinating work among subject matter experts and stakeholders; monitoring progress and outcomes; identifying and resolving barriers; and supporting the adoption and sustainability of improvements.
 
 
Projects vary in size, complexity, duration, and organizational impact. Depending on the scope and complexity of assigned initiatives, the position may lead a single large-scale project or manage multiple concurrent projects. The role works across organizational boundaries and relies on collaboration, facilitation, strategic influence, and effective stakeholder engagement to advance initiatives and achieve measurable improvements in support of ASOD priorities.

 

**Minimum Education and Experience Requirements**

Master’s or Bachelor’s and 0-2 years’ experience; or will accept a combination of related education and experience in substitution.

 

**Required Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience**

Demonstrated knowledge of project management, change management, organizational improvement, and problem-solving principles, with the ability to apply these concepts to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
 
 
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to assess organizational and operational challenges, evaluate potential solutions, develop actionable recommendations, and use qualitative and quantitative information to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
 
 
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with leaders and stakeholders across multiple functional areas and organizational levels and to facilitate change and influence outcomes without direct supervisory authority.
 
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings and discussions, present information and recommendations, and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
 
 
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, monitor progress and outcomes, and adapt to changing organizational needs.

 

**Preferred Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience**

Experience leading complex, cross-functional or organization-wide projects, strategic initiatives, operational reviews, or organizational improvement efforts.
 
 
Demonstrated experience applying project management and change management methodologies to the planning and implementation of complex initiatives.
 
 
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred. Formal training or certification in organizational change management methodologies, such as Prosci Change Management Certification or an equivalent program, is highly desirable.
 
 
Experience facilitating collaborative problem-solving and solution-design activities with senior leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
 
 
Experience developing performance measures, analyzing outcomes, and using data and metrics to evaluate effectiveness and support continuous improvement.
 
 
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and develop clear recommendations, presentations, and other communications for senior leadership and diverse stakeholder groups.
 
 
Experience working within a complex organization, preferably in higher education, academic health care, or a similarly decentralized environment.
 
 
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience using project management, collaboration, data visualization, or related business tools.

 

**Special Physical/Mental Requirements**

 

**Campus Security Authority Responsibilities**

This position is designated as a Campus Security Authority in accordance with the Clery Act. This position will be required to report Clery crimes to the Clery Compliance Manager and complete annual training about reporting responsibilities.

Sr. Director, Operational Excellence

**Position Summary**
====================

The Senior Director of Operational Excellence serves as a key strategic and operational partner to the Vice President of Operations, responsible for driving enterprise-wide operational initiatives, workforce optimization, project execution, and organizational effectiveness across CRH Healthcare.

This leader provides direct oversight of the centralized Provider Scheduling team, ensuring effective scheduling operations, proactive coverage planning, workforce utilization, and continuous process improvement. Additionally, the Sr. Director partners with regional and cross-functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, establish accountability, identify operational improvement opportunities, and ensure consistent execution across the organization. The position requires a balance of strategic thinking, hands-on leadership, financial acumen, and the ability to independently drive results in a complex, multi-site healthcare environment.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

**Operational Excellence & Executive Support**
----------------------------------------------

* Serve as a strategic operational partner to the VP of Operations, translating enterprise priorities into actionable execution plans, establishing accountability across functional teams, and ensuring initiatives are delivered on time with measurable operational and financial outcomes.
* Develop and maintain standardized operational performance through reporting that identifies trends, variances, and opportunities across regions. Partner with operational leadership to develop corrective action plans, monitor progress, and ensure sustained improvement.
* Ensure operational excellence with vendors and processes that support the business, including procurement, surveys, and regulatory requirements.
* Support the VP of Operations in evaluating competing priorities, organizational capacity, and resource allocation to ensure alignment with enterprise objectives.
* Develop operational process workflow structure, and communication and training plans to implement, along with feedback loop and tracking to measure success and/or challenge.
* Other duties as assigned by the VP of Operations.

**Workforce Optimization**
--------------------------

* Direct and oversee the centralized Provider Scheduling team, including performance, workload, service expectations and escalation practices.
* Oversee provider scheduling processes, capacity visibility, coverage planning and coordination with regional operational leaders. Identify recurring coverage risks, utilization opportunities and avoidable scheduling disruptions.
* Coordinate with Operational Leadership, Talent Acquisition and Finance on workforce demand, hiring priorities, and labor cost trends.

**Project Management**
----------------------

* Lead full project lifecycle, from planning to closeout for operational initiatives.
* Establish project governance, prioritization, milestones, risks and executive reporting.
* Develop stakeholder engagement, communication, training and adoption plans to sustain operational change.
* Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, and deliverables effectively.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, operations or related field.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, workforce management, project delivery or operational excellence.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading managers or functional teams multi-stie environment with a distributed field force.
* Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations; urgent care or ambulatory care experience preferred.
* Proven ability to lead teams, drive change, influence business partners, and deliver operational results through data-driven decision making, stakeholder collaboration, and organizational influence.
* Strong project portfolio governance, change management, workforce analytics, financial acumen and stakeholder influence.
* Ability to lead through partnerships and remote workforce.
* Office based position with approximately 25% travel to company clinics.

*CRH Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. All offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable credentialing, licensure verification, background review, and employment requirements.*

existing_roles.description:
Medical Practice Administration | Muncie Primary Care

Full-Time | On-Site | Monday–Friday

Competitive annual salary, depending on experience and qualifications, with the opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.

45 Years of Excellence. An Exciting Future Ahead.

Founded in 1981, Muncie Primary Care is a family-owned, independent primary care practice with deep roots in East Central Indiana.

For 45 years, we've built our reputation on exceptional patient care, strong community relationships, and a commitment to independent medicine. Today, the next generation of physician leadership is carrying that legacy forward.

With a newly renovated facility and continued investments in our people, technology, and patient experience, we're excited about what's ahead.

We're proud of what we've built. We're looking for someone who's excited to help us make it even better.

*This Isn't Your Typical Office Manager Position.*

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking Director of Operations who can serve as the second-in-command to our physician-owner and CEO, leading the day-to-day operations of our practice while helping us build a stronger, more efficient organization for the future.

This is a true leadership position focused on developing people, improving processes, strengthening accountability, overseeing financial and operational performance, and turning ideas into action.

**What You'll Do**

1. Lead Operations and Financial Performance

* Provide overall leadership and oversight of daily practice operations, ensuring that clinical and administrative departments work together efficiently.
* Identify operational challenges, develop practical solutions, and address issues proactively before they escalate.
* Oversee operational budgets, monitor expenses, review financial performance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Work with designated team members responsible for administrative functions, technology, vendor coordination, and other business operations to ensure these responsibilities are managed effectively.
* Establish clear systems for delegation, communication, follow-through, and accountability.
* Ensure appropriate processes are in place for regulatory compliance, organizational policies, and operational risk management.

2. Lead, Develop, and Support Our Team

* Build and maintain strong, positive working relationships with employees across all departments.
* Develop departmental leaders, encourage professional growth, and help employees succeed in their roles.
* Foster a workplace culture built on mutual respect, open communication, teamwork, and accountability.
* Provide coaching, performance feedback, and support with difficult conversations and conflict resolution.
* Address employee concerns and interpersonal challenges fairly, promptly, and professionally.
* Work collaboratively with our Marketing/Human Resources Manager on recruitment, employee development, retention, and performance management.
* Strengthen communication and cooperation between clinical and administrative departments.

3. Improve Systems and Use Data to Drive Decisions

* Develop, monitor, and analyze Key Result Areas (KRAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), scheduling utilization, productivity, and other operational performance measures.
* Identify inefficiencies, evaluate workflows, and implement improvements that enhance patient access, employee satisfaction, and practice performance.
* Build systems that promote consistency, clear responsibilities, effective delegation, and measurable accountability.
* Use spreadsheets, dashboards, financial information, and operational data to identify trends and guide decision-making.
* Evaluate the results of operational changes and make adjustments as needed.
* Help create an organization where problems are identified early and addressed effectively.

4. Help Shape the Future of Our Practice

* Partner directly with the physician-owner and CEO on strategic planning, organizational priorities, and practice improvement initiatives.
* Translate long-term goals into practical action plans, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technology to reduce administrative burden and improve efficiency.
* Take ownership of projects from initial planning through implementation and evaluation.
* Anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and bring forward thoughtful solutions and recommendations.
* Help balance the needs of patients, providers, employees, and the business while supporting the long-term success of independent primary care.

**You might be a great candidate for this position if….**

* You're a natural leader who enjoys developing people, building relationships, and helping teams succeed.
* You build trust and respect while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
* You're proactive, resourceful, and comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and taking ownership of outcomes.
* You communicate effectively, navigate difficult conversations professionally, and foster collaboration across departments.
* You enjoy improving processes, building efficient systems, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're comfortable using financial information, spreadsheets, and performance metrics to guide decisions.
* You're excited about new technology, including AI and automation, and enjoy working with an engaged owner who values initiative and independent thinking.

**This Position May Not Be the Right Fit If...**

* You prefer a traditional office management role focused on completing daily administrative tasks.
* You're most comfortable waiting for direction rather than taking ownership of challenges.
* You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than finding a better way to do things.
* You find it difficult to address employee performance concerns or navigate uncomfortable conversations.
* You tend to focus on identifying problems without taking responsibility for developing and implementing solutions.
* You aren't comfortable using data, financial information, or technology to evaluate performance and guide decisions.

We recognize that no candidate will bring every skill or have every answer on day one. We're looking for someone with the leadership ability, judgment, curiosity, and initiative to learn, adapt, and grow with our practice.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Demonstrated leadership and management experience, including supervising employees, developing teams, and overseeing complex operational workflows.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build productive working relationships.
* Experience coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, resolving conflicts, and fostering an accountable, team-oriented workplace.
* Proven ability to identify operational problems, implement solutions, and follow projects through to completion.
* Experience managing business operations, delegating responsibilities, and coordinating work across departments.
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to make independent decisions.
* Comfort with technology, willingness to learn new tools, and an interest in using data to improve operational performance.

**Strongly Preferred**

* A bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, management, or a related field.

**Why Muncie Primary Care?**

We're an established, family-owned practice that values our employees, our patients, and our independence. We're proud of our history and equally excited about our future.

As our Director of Operations, you'll have:

* The opportunity to shape the systems, culture, and future direction of an established practice.
* Competitive base salary
* Opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.
* Monday–Friday work schedule.
* Health insurance.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* Retirement benefits, subject to plan eligibility.

**Ready to Help Us Take the Next Step Forward?**

We're not looking for someone who has all the answers.

We're looking for someone who asks great questions, builds strong relationships, takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is excited about building something meaningful.

If you're an experienced leader who loves developing people, improving systems, taking ownership, and helping an organization succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Leadership and Initiative: Tell us about a process, system, or operational improvement you personally led. What was the problem, what did you change, and what was the result?
* Difficult Conversations: Describe a time you had to address a difficult situation with an employee or colleague involving performance, accountability, or workplace behavior. How did you approach the conversation, and what was the outcome?
* Data and Decision-Making: Tell us about a time you used data, performance metrics, or other measurable information to identify a problem or make a decision. What did you learn, and what action did you take?

Location:

* Muncie, IN 47304 (Preferred)

existing_roles.title: Plant Manager III
existing_roles.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter.

 

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Plant Manager will provide overall leadership for the phased development, start-up, ramp-up, and ongoing operation of the new lithium-ion cell manufacturing facility in Greenville, South Carolina. This is a unique opportunity to build a factory and its organization from the ground up in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment.

The role will evolve through multiple phases of the project, beginning with facility construction and operational readiness and progressing through equipment installation and commissioning, production launch, workforce ramp-up, stabilization, and full-scale manufacturing operations.

The Plant Manager will be accountable for establishing the operating model, leadership capability, organizational structure, culture, management systems, and performance disciplines required to achieve excellence across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, people, and customer satisfaction.

This leader must bring broad manufacturing expertise in a high-volume, fully automated environment and understand the interdependencies across production, engineering, maintenance, quality, supply chain, materials, EHS, finance, and people. The successful candidate will combine strong operational and financial acumen with knowledge of lithium-ion cell manufacturing and a demonstrated ability to build organizations, develop leaders, anticipate workforce needs, and establish strong relationships with employees, customers, suppliers, and business partners.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Factory Development, Start-Up & Operational Readiness**

* Provide operational leadership throughout the phased development of the Greenville facility, ensuring manufacturing and operational requirements are incorporated as the factory is constructed, commissioned, launched, and scaled.
* Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, EHS, People & Culture, IT/OT, and other functions to establish comprehensive manufacturing readiness.
* Translate facility and project milestones into executable operational plans covering equipment, processes, workforce, training, materials, systems, safety, quality, and infrastructure.
* Ensure equipment, manufacturing processes, systems, organizational capability, and workforce readiness progress together so that potential gaps are identified and resolved before they impact production.
* Establish the operating systems, standard work, governance, performance metrics, escalation processes, and accountability required to transition successfully from project execution into manufacturing operations.
* Lead the operational transition through equipment installation and commissioning, qualification, production launch, ramp-up, stabilization, and full-scale operations.

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**

* Provide end-to-end leadership of plant operations with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, capacity, employee performance, and overall manufacturing results.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of plant operating processes and ensure effective integration across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, supply chain, materials, EHS, and supporting functions.
* Establish a culture of operational excellence, disciplined execution, accountability, continuous improvement, and structured problem solving.
* Establish and continuously evaluate plant KPIs to identify performance gaps, determine root causes, and drive sustainable corrective actions.
* Drive improvement in manufacturing productivity, equipment effectiveness, reliability, throughput, yield, quality, labor efficiency, and operating cost.
* Ensure appropriate manufacturing systems, controls, procedures, and escalation mechanisms are established as production volume and organizational complexity increase.
* Champion Lean manufacturing principles and create a culture in which continuous improvement is embedded throughout the organization.

**Lithium-Ion Cell Manufacturing**

* Provide leadership within a technically complex lithium-ion cell manufacturing environment.
* Apply practical knowledge of cell manufacturing processes, automated manufacturing equipment, process controls, materials, quality requirements, and production risks to operational decision-making.
* Work closely with Cell Engineering, Process Engineering, Quality, EHS, and other technical teams to establish safe, repeatable, high-quality manufacturing processes capable of operating at scale.
* Ensure plant teams understand the relationships among process capability, product quality, yield, throughput, equipment performance, manufacturing cost, and customer requirements.
* Support the effective introduction, industrialization, and scale-up of new manufacturing processes and technologies.

**Financial & Business Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Own plant operating performance from both an operational and financial perspective.
* Develop and manage plant operating budgets, forecasts, labor plans, productivity targets, capital requirements, and cost-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of the economic drivers of manufacturing and translate operational performance into financial and business outcomes.
* Partner closely with Finance to understand and manage manufacturing cost, labor, productivity, inventory, scrap, yield, capital utilization, and other key plant performance drivers.
* Evaluate significant operational decisions through both manufacturing and financial lenses, balancing immediate execution requirements with the long-term capability and competitiveness of the plant.
* Establish strong cost-management and financial disciplines as the facility transitions from construction and start-up investment to sustainable manufacturing operations.

**Workforce Planning & Organizational Capability**

* Build the plant organization in phases aligned with facility construction, commissioning, production launch, ramp-up, and future operating requirements.
* Develop short- and long-term workforce plans to ensure the plant has the appropriate leadership, technical, skilled-trades, professional, and manufacturing capabilities required at each stage of growth.
* Anticipate talent, capacity, skill, and leadership gaps before they become constraints to manufacturing performance or future growth.
* Partner closely with People & Culture to develop recruiting, workforce planning, onboarding, training, retention, employee engagement, talent management, and organizational capability strategies.
* Establish clear organizational structures, decision rights, accountabilities, and leadership responsibilities as the facility grows and becomes operational.
* Develop workforce flexibility and organizational depth to mitigate single points of dependency and ensure business continuity.
* Regularly assess whether workforce capacity and capability are appropriately aligned with production requirements, operating plans, and future growth.

**Leadership Development & Succession**

* Recruit, build, coach, and develop a high-performing plant leadership team capable of successfully operating at increasing levels of scale and complexity.
* Establish a leadership culture where leaders are expected not only to deliver results but also to develop other leaders and build capability within their organizations.
* Partner with People & Culture to regularly assess leadership capability, organizational effectiveness, succession coverage, bench strength, and future talent requirements.
* Build strong succession pipelines for critical plant leadership and technical positions and ensure appropriate development plans are established for potential successors.
* Identify and develop high-potential talent through coaching, mentoring, expanded responsibilities, cross-functional experience, and targeted development opportunities.
* Establish sufficient leadership and technical depth to minimize organizational vulnerability and ensure continuity as the facility grows.
* Create a culture where talent development and succession planning are ongoing leadership responsibilities rather than periodic HR activities.

**Customer, Supplier & Stakeholder Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Build strong, credible, long-term relationships with customers and ensure plant execution consistently supports quality, delivery, responsiveness, and customer commitments.
* Build strategic relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers, contractors, and other external partners critical to the construction, start-up, and ongoing operation of the plant.
* Work collaboratively with customers and suppliers to resolve issues quickly while protecting long-term business relationships.
* Serve as a senior representative of the Greenville operation with business leadership, customers, suppliers, community stakeholders, and other external partners as appropriate.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships across the broader organization and effectively navigate a complex, matrixed environment.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the plant and foster an employee environment built on communication, engagement, trust, accountability, and strong employee relations.

**Safety, Quality & Culture**

* Establish safety as a foundational operating principle and ensure appropriate systems, behaviors, and leadership accountability are embedded throughout the facility.
* Champion a quality-first mindset and ensure the organization consistently meets internal requirements and customer expectations.
* Build a high-performance culture characterized by accountability, collaboration, transparency, urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear expectations for leadership behavior and ensure those expectations cascade throughout the plant organization.
